name: International Journal of Fungi
scope: Fungal Taxonomy, Systematics, and Evolution: Research on fungal classification, nomenclature, species delimitation, phylogenetics, molecular systematics, DNA barcoding, morphological characterization, evolutionary relationships, and discovery of novel fungal taxa. Fungal Genetics, Genomics, and Epigenetics: Studies on fungal genomes, genetic diversity, gene regulation, comparative genomics, transcriptomics, population genetics, epigenetic mechanisms, RNA interference, genome editing, and functional analysis of fungal genes. Fungal Molecular and Cellular Biology: Research on fungal cell structure, cell walls, membranes, intracellular organization, signal transduction, gene expression, proteomics, metabolomics, molecular diagnostics, and cellular mechanisms underlying fungal growth, development, and adaptation. Fungal Physiology and Biochemistry: Studies on fungal metabolism, respiration, nutrient utilization, reproduction, development, stress responses, enzyme systems, secondary metabolites, toxins, lipids, and biochemical pathways involved in fungal survival and function. Fungal Ecology and Biodiversity: Research on fungal communities, biogeography, ecological succession, decomposition, nutrient cycling, ecosystem functions, fungal diversity, conservation, endophytes, saprotrophs, symbiotic fungi, and ecological responses to environmental change. Mycorrhizal Fungi and Plant–Fungus Interactions: Studies on arbuscular and ectomycorrhizal associations, nutrient exchange, plant growth promotion, root colonization, fungal symbioses, plant immunity, rhizosphere interactions, and the role of fungi in plant health and productivity. Medical Mycology and Fungal Pathogenesis: Research on fungal infections of humans and animals, virulence, host–fungus interactions, epidemiology, diagnosis, immune responses, pathogenic mechanisms, fungal biofilms, and emerging or opportunistic fungal pathogens. Antifungal Agents and Drug Resistance: Studies on antifungal drug discovery, mechanisms of action, resistance mechanisms, susceptibility testing, therapeutic strategies, fungal vaccine development, combination therapy, and novel approaches for managing fungal infections. Agricultural and Plant Pathogenic Fungi: Research on fungal diseases of crops, plant-pathogen interactions, epidemiology, diagnostics, disease resistance, integrated disease management, fungal biocontrol, biofertilizers, and sustainable fungal applications in agriculture. Fungal Biotechnology and Industrial Applications: Studies on fungal enzymes, fermentation, biocatalysis, bioconversion, bioreactors, biofuels, biomaterials, recombinant products, industrial metabolites, fungal bioprocessing, and large-scale applications of fungi in biotechnology. Fungal Bioremediation and Environmental Applications: Research on fungal degradation of pollutants, pesticides, hydrocarbons, dyes, plastics, heavy metals, and other contaminants, including mycoremediation, wastewater treatment, soil restoration, phytoremediation partnerships, and environmental biotechnology. Mushroom Biology and Cultivation: Studies on edible, medicinal, wild, and commercially important mushrooms, including cultivation, genetics, physiology, nutrition, postharvest quality, bioactive compounds, production systems, and sustainable mushroom technologies. Yeast Biology and Fermentation: Research on yeasts, including Saccharomyces and non- Saccharomyces species, covering metabolism, genetics, fermentation, ethanol production, baking, brewing, wine-making, industrial biotechnology, stress tolerance, and yeast viability. Fungal Secondary Metabolites and Natural Products: Studies on mycotoxins, antibiotics, pigments, polysaccharides, terpenoids, alkaloids, bioactive peptides, nutraceuticals, and other fungal-derived compounds with pharmaceutical, agricultural, industrial, or health-related applications. Lichens and Symbiotic Fungal Systems: Research on lichenized fungi, fungal-algal or fungal-cyanobacterial associations, ecological functions, taxonomy, physiology, secondary metabolites, environmental monitoring, biomonitoring, and adaptations to extreme environments. Food, Fermentation, and Fungal Safety: Studies on fungi in food production, spoilage, mycotoxin contamination, fermented foods and beverages, food safety, fungal quality control, preservation, beneficial fungal cultures, and industrial fermentation systems. Fungal Conservation and Environmental Change: Research on threatened fungi, conservation priorities, habitat loss, climate change, pollution, land-use change, fungal population decline, restoration, and strategies for conserving fungal diversity and ecosystem functions. Emerging and Interdisciplinary Mycology: Research integrating mycology with bioinformatics, omics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, agriculture, medicine, environmental science, food science, biotechnology, and other disciplines where fungi form the central scientific focus. The updated scope consolidates the journal’s existing coverage of taxonomy, genetics, ecology, physiology, biotechnology, molecular biology, medical mycology, mushrooms, yeasts, lichens, and environmental applications into clearer contemporary research domains.

name: International Journal of Fracture Mechanics and Damage Science
subject_areas: Elastic instability, Gross plastic deformation, Tensile instability
Low and high cycle fatigue damage
Ductile/plastic damage, corrosion of metals, alloys
Strain softening and strain-rate sensitivity damage
Impact damage, mechanical characterization of composites
Elastic-plastic, Wear behavior of composites, metal Metrix composites, hybrid composites, fly ash etc
Crack incubation and propagation, gas exhaustion. engine exhaustion  Crack and fracture repair Techniques
scope: The journal welcomes original research articles, theoretical and computational papers, systematic literature reviews, case studies, short communications, and invited editorials in the following thematic areas: Elastic Instability and Plastic Deformation: fracture toughness and fracture mechanics fundamentals, plastic zone analysis and stress-strain behavior, cleavage and ductile crack growth, elastic-plastic transition phenomena, deformation limits and failure criteria, and structural response to tension and shear loading. Fatigue and Cyclic Damage: low-cycle and high-cycle fatigue phenomena, fatigue crack initiation and propagation, creep-fatigue interaction and synergistic damage, mean stress effects and stress relaxation, ultrasonic and conventional fatigue testing, and life prediction models for cyclic loading. Creep Damage and Time-Dependent Fracture: creep deformation and rupture in high-temperature applications, creep-fatigue damage assessment methodologies, stress relaxation and strain-rate sensitivity, time-dependent damage accumulation, and material behavior under sustained and cyclic thermal loading. Brittle Fracture and Damage Mechanics: brittle-to-ductile transition phenomena, phase-field modeling of fracture, crack propagation analysis, damage rheology, friction and wear mechanics, and finite element and computational fracture analysis. Corrosion Damage and Environmentally-Assisted Cracking: metal and alloy corrosion, localized and stress corrosion cracking, pipeline and riser corrosion in oil and gas systems, galvanic and electrochemical damage, material selection and protection strategies, and long-term durability under corrosive environments. Composite Materials and Impact Damage: fiber-reinforced polymer (FRP) composites, carbon fiber and carbon nanotube composites, hybrid composite systems, metal matrix composites, polymer matrix composites, impact behavior and dynamic mechanical analysis, and composite damage mechanics and characterization. Wear and Erosion Damage: wear-rate analysis and friction behavior, solid particle erosion of composites and metals, wear behavior of hybrid and fly-ash reinforced materials, design of wear-resistant materials, and tribological assessment methodologies. Crack Mechanics and Repair Technologies: small fatigue crack behavior, foreign object damage and dwell fatigue in aerospace materials, nickel-based superalloys and titanium alloys, crack initiation and growth analysis, replica and electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) techniques, and crack repair and mitigation strategies. Modeling and Numerical Simulation: computational fracture mechanics and finite element analysis, digital image correlation (DIC) and experimental validation, stress triaxiality and ductile damage modeling, damage state variables, multiphysics coupling (thermal, mechanical, chemical), and data-driven and machine learning approaches.

name: International Journal of Green Chemistry
subject_areas: The development of environmentally improved routes, synthetic methods, and processes to an important product
Methodologies and tools for measuring environmental impact and application to real-world examples
The use of biotechnology alternatives to chemistry-based solutions
Characterization of natural and affected environments
Behavior, prevention, treatment, and control of mineral, organic and radioactive pollutants
Interfacial studies involving media such as soil, sediment, water, air, organism, and food
Green chemistry, environmentally friendly synthetic pathways, and alternative fuels
Environmental analytical chemistry, biomolecular tools, and tracers e.g., stable isotopes
The application of innovative technology to establish industrial procedures
scope: Sustainable synthetic routes: environmentally improved synthetic methods, solvent-free and benign-solvent reactions, atom economy and waste minimisation, microwave- and ultrasound-assisted synthesis, and process route selection and optimisation. Green catalysis: heterogeneous and recyclable catalysts, photocatalysis, electrocatalysis, biocatalysis and enzymatic transformations, and catalyst design for reduced energy and reagent demand. Renewable feedstocks and biomass valorisation: lignocellulosic conversion, hemicellulose and lignin-derived chemicals, bio-based and biodegradable polymers, polyhydroxyalkanoates, waste-derived feedstocks, and substitution of fossil-based raw materials. Alternative fuels and chemical aspects of renewable energy: biodiesel production and fuel properties, biomass pretreatment and thermochemical and biochemical conversion, hydrogen production, CO₂ capture and utilisation, and chemistry of energy storage systems. Green materials chemistry: green synthesis of nanomaterials, graphene and carbon materials, metal-organic frameworks and zeolites, ion-exchange and adsorbent materials, and biocomposites. Environmental analytical chemistry: environmental monitoring methods, biosensors and immunoassays, spectroscopic and chromatographic techniques, speciation analysis, stable-isotope tracers, and compound-specific isotope analysis. Pollutant behaviour and fate: occurrence, mobility, and transformation of organic, inorganic, and radioactive pollutants, adsorption and desorption processes, persistent organic pollutants, microplastics, heavy metals, and pharmaceutical residues in environmental compartments. Interfacial and multimedia processes: partitioning across soil, sediment, water, air, and biota, air–surface exchange, transport in porous media, bioaccumulation and food-chain transfer, and multimedia fate modelling. Remediation and treatment technologies: bioremediation and bioaugmentation, phytoremediation and phytostabilisation, electro-remediation, adsorption and membrane processes including nanofiltration and reverse osmosis, wastewater and leachate treatment, and contaminant removal from soil and groundwater. Environmental assessment and modelling: life cycle assessment, ecological footprint analysis, strategic environmental assessment, risk assessment, environmental accounting, and simulation and sensitivity analysis of environmental systems. Cleaner production and industrial implementation: process intensification for reduced emissions, cleaner production practices, industrial scale-up of green processes, circular-economy approaches in chemical manufacturing, and techno-economic evaluation of sustainable alternatives.

name: International Journal of Geological and Geotechnical Engineering
subject_areas: Mechanical, Physical, Hydraulic, and Thermal Properties of Geomaterials
scope: Engineering geology: geological mapping for engineering purposes, lithological and structural controls on ground behaviour, weathering profiles and residual soils, discontinuity mapping and rock mass characterisation, geological model development for construction, and interpretation of regional geology in design. Hydrogeology and groundwater: aquifer characterisation and groundwater flow regimes, groundwater control and dewatering, seepage and permeability of geological formations, groundwater–excavation interaction, contaminant migration through geological media, and hydrogeological modelling. Geohazard identification and assessment: landslide inventory, susceptibility, and hazard mapping, rockfall and debris flow assessment, land subsidence and sinkhole formation, seismic hazard and fault characterisation, liquefaction susceptibility mapping, and multi-hazard assessment frameworks. Landslide and slope processes: slope failure mechanisms and classification, triggering thresholds including rainfall and seismic loading, runout modelling, natural slope monitoring, and stabilisation and mitigation of geohazard-prone slopes. Geospatial methods and remote sensing: GIS-based spatial analysis of ground conditions, satellite and airborne imagery interpretation, InSAR and ground deformation monitoring, LiDAR and photogrammetric terrain modelling, digital elevation analysis, and spatial data integration for site selection and risk zoning. Site characterisation and subsurface investigation: exploration strategy and borehole logging, geophysical survey methods including seismic, resistivity, and ground-penetrating radar, in-situ testing for geological units, sampling and core description, and three-dimensional ground model construction. Rock engineering: rock mass classification and rating systems, rock strength and deformability, in-situ stress regimes, rock slope stability, excavation and support design in rock, blasting and fragmentation, and rock–structure interaction. Mining geotechnics: open pit and underground mine slope and excavation stability, ground support and reinforcement in mining, subsidence prediction over mine workings, tailings and waste rock storage facilities, mine closure and rehabilitation, and geotechnical risk management in mining operations. Tunnelling and underground works in geological context: ground classification for tunnelling, face stability and ground response, karst, fault zone, and squeezing ground conditions, groundwater inflow prediction, and observational method application. Geotechnical instrumentation and monitoring: inclinometers, extensometers, and settlement monitoring, piezometric and pore pressure measurement, automated and remote monitoring systems, early warning systems for geohazards, and interpretation of monitoring data for design verification. Geoenvironmental and sustainable ground engineering: landfill siting and containment in geological settings, contaminated land assessment and remediation, use of recycled and secondary materials in ground works, carbon and energy assessment of geotechnical solutions, and geothermal and ground energy systems. Numerical and analytical modelling: finite element and finite difference modelling of geological media, discrete element and discontinuum analysis, coupled hydro-mechanical modelling, probabilistic and reliability approaches to geological uncertainty, and calibration against field observation.

name: Indian Journal of Health & Medical Laws
subject_areas: Mental Health Laws and Patients’ Rights
Consumer Protection Laws in the Medical Profession
Regulation of Transplantation of Human Organs
Pharmacy, Bio-Medical Waste, Drugs and Cosmetics Acts
Prevention of Food Adulteration and Narcotic Drugs Laws
Maternity Benefit, PNDT, Medical Termination of Pregnancy Laws
scope: Health and Medical Law: Research on legal principles, statutory frameworks, judicial decisions, and regulatory policies governing healthcare delivery, medical practice, public health, patient protection, and the responsibilities of healthcare institutions and professionals. Patients’ Rights and Medical Ethics: Studies on informed consent, confidentiality, privacy, dignity, autonomy, refusal of treatment, disclosure of medical information, end-of-life decisions, professional ethics, clinical ethics, and the legal protection of patients’ rights. Medical Negligence and Professional Liability: Research on standards of care, medical malpractice, professional misconduct, hospital liability, vicarious liability, evidentiary issues, compensation, and civil, criminal, or regulatory consequences arising from negligent healthcare. Public Health Law and Policy: Studies on legislation and policy relating to disease prevention, vaccination, epidemics, public-health emergencies, sanitation, health surveillance, government powers, individual liberties, health equity, and state responsibility for population health. Mental Health Law and Patient Protection: Research on legal frameworks governing mental healthcare, capacity, consent, admission and discharge, involuntary treatment, confidentiality, supported decision-making, community care, and protection of the rights and dignity of persons with mental illness. Reproductive Health and Maternal Rights: Studies on reproductive autonomy, maternity benefits, abortion law, assisted reproductive technologies, surrogacy, prenatal diagnostics, sex-selection regulation, maternal healthcare, fertility treatment, and legal protection of reproductive rights. Organ and Tissue Transplantation Law: Research on organ donation, transplantation, consent, allocation, brain-death standards, living and deceased donors, commercial dealings, transplant tourism, regulatory oversight, and ethical and legal issues surrounding human organs and tissues. Pharmaceutical and Drug Regulation: Studies on drug approval, manufacture, distribution, clinical use, pricing, pharmacovigilance, prescription practices, counterfeit medicines, controlled substances, cosmetics regulation, and legal accountability of pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers. Clinical Trials and Biomedical Research Law: Research on ethics approval, informed consent, research participants’ rights, compensation for research-related injury, clinical-trial regulation, human-subject protection, biomedical innovation, data use, and legal oversight of medical research. Food Safety and Health Regulation: Studies on food standards, contamination, adulteration, labelling, foodborne illness, safety compliance, regulatory enforcement, risk assessment, food-business responsibility, and legal mechanisms for protecting public health through food regulation. Healthcare Consumer Protection: Research on patient-consumer rights, misleading medical claims, deficient healthcare services, insurance disputes, unfair practices, hospital billing, grievance redressal, compensation, and the application of consumer-protection principles to healthcare. Health Insurance and Healthcare Financing Law: Studies on health insurance contracts, coverage, exclusions, claims, reimbursement, public health schemes, medical expenses, insurer obligations, fraud prevention, and legal issues arising from healthcare financing and access. Bioethics, Biotechnology, and Emerging Medical Technologies: Research on genetics, genomics, stem-cell research, gene editing, biobanking, cloning, artificial intelligence in healthcare, digital diagnostics, precision medicine, and ethical and legal challenges created by emerging biomedical technologies. Digital Health, Telemedicine, and Health Data Protection: Studies on telemedicine, electronic health records, health applications, wearable devices, digital prescriptions, medical data privacy, cybersecurity, cross-border health-data transfers, artificial intelligence, and liability in technology-enabled healthcare. Biomedical Waste and Environmental Health Law: Research on biomedical-waste management, hazardous healthcare waste, infection-control obligations, hospital environmental compliance, disposal standards, occupational exposure, and regulatory responsibility for healthcare-related environmental risks. Human Rights and Healthcare: Studies on the right to health, equality in healthcare, discrimination, disability rights, access to essential medicines, healthcare for vulnerable populations, custodial healthcare, reproductive justice, and international human-rights standards relevant to medical care. Healthcare Regulation and Institutional Governance: Research on licensing, accreditation, hospital governance, professional councils, regulatory authorities, disciplinary procedures, clinical standards, compliance systems, healthcare fraud, and accountability of public and private healthcare institutions. Indian Health and Medical Law and Comparative Perspectives: Research on Indian legislation, judicial decisions, healthcare regulation, medical ethics, patient rights, pharmaceutical law, public-health policy, and medical-professional accountability. Comparative and international scholarship is welcome where health or medical law forms the central legal contribution.

name: International Journal of Insects
subject_areas: Insect behavior, including mating behavior, foraging, and social behavior
Insect physiology, including development, growth, and reproduction
Insect genetics and genomics, including molecular and cellular aspects
Insect-borne diseases, including the biology and control of disease vectors
scope: Insect Diversity, Taxonomy, and Systematics: Research on insect identification, classification, nomenclature, morphology, systematics, phylogenetics, species delimitation, biogeography, biodiversity inventories, museum collections, and the discovery and description of insect taxa. Insect Ecology and Ecosystem Interactions: Studies on insect populations and communities, habitat associations, competition, predation, parasitism, mutualism, herbivory, pollination, food webs, ecosystem services, and interactions between insects and terrestrial or aquatic environments. Insect Behavior and Chemical Ecology: Research on mating, courtship, sexual selection, foraging, host selection, communication, pheromones, territoriality, social organization, parental care, cooperation, aggression, learning, and chemical mechanisms influencing insect behavior. Insect Physiology and Development: Studies on growth, molting, metamorphosis, endocrinology, reproduction, embryonic and larval development, diapause, circadian rhythms, metabolism, sensory physiology, aging, and physiological responses to environmental conditions. Insect Genetics, Genomics, and Molecular Biology: Research on insect genomes, gene expression, genetic variation, population genetics, transcriptomics, molecular evolution, RNA interference, genome editing, cellular signaling, neurogenetics, immunogenetics, and molecular mechanisms underlying insect traits. Insect Evolution and Phylogeny: Studies on insect origins, diversification, speciation, natural selection, adaptive radiation, coevolution, evolutionary developmental biology, fossil insects, comparative morphology, phylogenomics, and evolutionary relationships among insect groups. Agricultural and Forest Entomology: Research on insect pests affecting crops, forests, stored products, horticultural systems, and plantations, including pest biology, crop–insect interactions, economic damage, monitoring, forecasting, and environmentally responsible management strategies. Integrated Pest Management and Biological Control: Studies on biological control agents, parasitoids, predators, entomopathogens, host-plant resistance, cultural and behavioral control, pheromone-based management, sterile insect techniques, insecticide resistance, pest risk analysis, and integrated pest management. Insecticide Toxicology and Resistance: Research on insecticide modes of action, toxicity, resistance mechanisms, resistance monitoring, pesticide metabolism, behavioral resistance, cross-resistance, resistance management, and development of safer or more selective pest-control approaches. Medical and Veterinary Entomology: Studies on mosquitoes, flies, fleas, lice, ticks and other arthropod vectors of human and animal disease, including vector biology, ecology, behavior, pathogen transmission, surveillance, prevention, and control. Vector-Borne Diseases and Public Health Entomology: Research on malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Zika, filariasis, leishmaniasis and other vector-associated diseases, including vector competence, epidemiology, insecticide-treated interventions, biological control, genetically modified vectors, and disease-surveillance strategies. Pollination Biology and Beneficial Insects: Studies on bees, butterflies, moths, beetles and other beneficial insects involved in pollination, biological control, decomposition, nutrient cycling, and ecosystem functioning, including their ecological and agricultural importance. Social Insects and Eusociality: Research on ants, bees, termites, wasps and other social insects, including caste systems, division of labor, communication, colony organization, kin selection, reproductive strategies, collective behavior, and evolution of sociality. Insect Conservation and Biodiversity Management: Studies on threatened insects, habitat loss, fragmentation, restoration, protected areas, population monitoring, conservation genetics, migration, habitat connectivity, citizen science, and strategies for maintaining insect diversity and ecosystem functions. Invasive Insects, Quarantine, and Biosecurity: Research on invasive insect species, pathways of introduction, establishment and spread, ecological and economic impacts, pest risk assessment, quarantine systems, surveillance, early detection, eradication, and biosecurity management. Insect–Plant Interactions: Studies on herbivory, pollination, host-plant selection, plant defenses, insect adaptation, gall formation, seed predation, coevolution, plant-mediated interactions, and molecular or chemical mechanisms governing relationships between insects and plants. Insect Microbiomes and Host–Microbe Interactions: Research on insect-associated bacteria, fungi, viruses and other microorganisms, including symbiosis, gut microbiomes, nutrition, immunity, pathogen interactions, reproductive manipulation, disease resistance, and applications in pest or vector management. Climate Change and Insect Biology: Studies on the effects of temperature, precipitation, extreme events, habitat shifts, seasonal change and other climate-related factors on insect distribution, phenology, population dynamics, migration, pest outbreaks, vector ecology, and biodiversity. Applied and Industrial Entomology: Research on insects of economic importance, including apiculture, sericulture, lac culture, edible insects, insect-derived products, mass rearing, insect farming, biological resources, and sustainable applications of insects in agriculture and industry. Emerging Technologies in Entomology: Studies using artificial intelligence, remote sensing, automated insect identification, biosensors, molecular diagnostics, genomics, environmental DNA, geographic information systems, computational modelling, and other emerging tools for insect research and management.

chemical synthesis, surfactants and detergents, lubricants and additives, cosmeceuticals and personal care ingredients, glycoscience applications, and natural products extraction Biodefense & name: International Journal of I.C. Engines and Gas Turbines
subject_areas: Two-stroke, Four-stroke, Five strokes, and Six-stroke engines
Industrial Gas turbines for power generation and mechanical drive
scope: Two-Stroke, Four-Stroke, Five-Stroke, and Six-Stroke Engines : Six-stroke cycle with water injection and steam expansion, exhaust heat recovery, acetylene-fueled engines, engine efficiency and performance. Ignition and Combustion : Spark-ignition and compression-ignition engines, dual-fuel and gaseous fuel operation, hydrogen and ammonia as fuels, diesel combustion, flame development, in-cylinder heat flux, transient heat transfer. Engine Cycles and Thermodynamic Modeling : Finite-time thermodynamics, reciprocating heat-engine cycles, quasi-dimensional engine models, thermodynamic cycle models, turbulent flame propagation, performance optimization. Wankel Rotary Engines and Alternative Configurations : Gasoline and hydrogen-fueled Wankel engines, hydrogen enrichment, lean operating limits, asynchronous ignition, emissions. Lubrication : Boundary lubrication, tribochemistry, surface chemistry, lubricant additives, alkyl chain length effects, monomolecular film design, shear strength of surface films. Fuels, Oxidizers, and Propellants : Energetic materials, nano-aluminum, thermites, burning rate, liquid propellants, chlorine oxide oxidizers, specific impulse, liquid rocket engines. Industrial Gas Turbines for Power Generation and Mechanical Drive : Design-point and off-design performance, zero-dimensional models, compressors, turbochargers, combined heat and power, heat recovery, low-emission combustion technologies, exhaust systems, maintenance, downtime, service life. Steam Turbines and Turbine Engine Failure : Steam turbine performance, failure analysis of turbine components, stress and service life assessment. Jet Engines : Aerospace engine control and computer control systems, turboprop engines, gamma titanium aluminide alloys, room-temperature ductility, gas tungsten arc welding (GTAW) of engine components. The journal publishes original research articles, review articles, case studies, and short communications summarizing recent work. Electric drivetrains, and vehicle design with no engine or turbine component, are out of scope. The journal serves automotive, aerospace, and power plant engineers, combustion and propulsion researchers, engine and turbine manufacturers, and graduate students.

name: International Journal of Immunological Nursing
subject_areas: Anatomy and Physiology of the Immune System
scope: The journal welcomes contributions across the following topic areas: Classical & Clinical Immunology: immune system anatomy and physiology, innate and adaptive immune responses, humoral and cell-mediated immunity, antibody production and function, antigen presentation and immune recognition, immunological assessment and testing, and clinical applications of immunological principles in patient care Immunology & Infectious Disease Nursing: nosocomial and community-acquired infections, sepsis and septic shock nursing care, immunocompromised host management, opportunistic infection prevention and treatment, cytokine storm and systemic inflammatory response, antimicrobial stewardship in nursing practice, and infection control protocols and implementation Autoimmunity & Connective Tissue Disorders: autoimmune disease pathophysiology and nursing assessment, systemic lupus erythematosus and related conditions, rheumatoid arthritis and joint disease management, thyroid autoimmunity and endocrine disorders, genetic and environmental factors in autoimmunity, disease-modifying antirheumatic drug nursing, and patient and family education in autoimmune care Hypersensitivity Reactions & Allergies: type I, II, III, and IV hypersensitivity reactions, anaphylaxis recognition and emergency management, allergic rhinitis and asthma nursing care, food and drug allergies and desensitization protocols, atopic dermatitis and urticaria management, serum sickness and delayed hypersensitivity reactions, and allergen avoidance and patient education Developmental Immunology: fetal immune system development and maturation, neonatal and infant immune response, maternal-neonatal antibody transfer and protection, childhood immunological development and vaccine response, adolescent and adult immune function, immunosenescence in aging populations, and age-appropriate immunological nursing interventions Immunotherapy & Biologic Agents: monoclonal antibody therapies and nursing administration, checkpoint inhibitor immunotherapy and side-effect management, cellular immunotherapy and chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy, immunomodulatory drugs and patient monitoring, targeted biologic therapies, adverse events and toxicity assessment, and nursing support in immunotherapy settings Reproductive Immunology & Pregnancy: maternal immune adaptations during pregnancy, immune tolerance and implantation success, recurrent pregnancy loss and immune factors, assisted reproductive technology and immune outcomes, pregnancy complications with immunological components, breastfeeding and passive immune transfer, and immunological factors in fertility and conception Vaccine Development & Immunization: vaccine immunogenicity and efficacy assessment, vaccine safety monitoring and adverse event reporting, immunization schedules and special populations, vaccine hesitancy and acceptance strategies, preventable disease epidemiology and burden of disease, post-vaccination immune response and protection duration, and nursing advocacy for immunization programs Infection Prevention & Control: healthcare-associated infection prevention, standard and transmission-based precautions, hand hygiene and asepsis in nursing practice, multi-drug-resistant organism management, healthcare worker safety and occupational exposure, environmental cleaning and disinfection, and infection control program evaluation and quality improvement Nursing Diagnosis, Assessment & Care Planning: immunological nursing diagnoses and care planning, patient education on immune health and disease prevention, medication administration and therapeutic monitoring, symptom management in immunological disorders, nutritional support for immune function, psychosocial support and coping strategies, and outcomes measurement and evaluation

name: International Journal of Industrial and Product Design Engineering
subject_areas: Statistical process control or quality control
scope: Operations Research and Optimization Techniques : Linear programming, integer programming, objective function and decision variable formulation, optimization models for industrial systems. Supply Chain Management and Logistics : Smart supply chains, Internet of Things (IoT) and Industry 4.0 in supply chains, radio frequency identification (RFID), supply chain process modeling, information analysis for logistics, pharmaceutical supply chains. Systems Simulation and Stochastic Processes : Simulation modeling, stochastic process analysis, random vibration, spectral analysis using fast Fourier transforms. Statistical Process Control and Quality Control : Control charts, batch and multivariable process monitoring, principal component analysis, fault diagnosis. Quality Assurance and Inventory Control : Quality assurance systems, quality improvement plans, economic production quantity (EPQ) models, inventory management, RFID-based inventory tracking. Predetermined Motion Time Systems : Methods-Time Measurement (MTM), Modular Arrangement of Predetermined Time Standards (MODAPTS), Maynard Operation Sequence Technique (MOST), assembly workload analysis, physical working conditions. Productivity Improvement : Productivity trends in manufacturing and construction, continuous improvement, program and project management, supply chain productivity. System and Personnel Safety : Personnel safety management in enterprises, mechanisms for ensuring worker safety, personnel potential and workforce management, machine control and protective systems, safety system testing. Product Design Engineering : Product design and development, design for manufacture and assembly, human factors in product design. Value Analysis and Product Reliability : Value analysis and value engineering, product quality and reliability assessment, degradation modeling, total quality management, health and safety in manufacturing and assembly systems. The journal publishes original research articles, review articles, editorials, and short communications. Structural engineering, pharmacology, and particle physics studies with no industrial engineering or product design application are out of scope. The journal serves industrial and manufacturing engineers, product designers, operations researchers, quality and safety professionals, and supply chain managers.

name: International Journal of Image Processing and Pattern Recognition
subject_areas: Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning in Image Processing
Big Data and Cloud-Based Image Analytics
3D Image Processing and Augmented/Virtual Reality Applications
Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and Ethical AI
scope: Image representation and analysis: image transforms and moment-based representations including Legendre, Zernike, and complex moments, multiscale and sparse representations, image sampling and reconstruction, noise sensitivity and information redundancy, and geometric invariance in representation. Image enhancement and restoration: denoising and deblurring, contrast and colour correction, artefact removal, inverse problem formulations, and learned restoration priors. Image and video compression: transform and predictive coding, lossless and lossy still image compression, colour transformation and quantisation, block- and segment-based video coding, motion estimation and compensation, rate–distortion optimisation, and learned compression methods. Feature extraction and representation learning: global and local descriptors, pixel- and region-level feature extraction, biologically inspired hierarchical feature models, colour space selection and filtering, handcrafted versus learned features, and feature selection and fusion. Pattern recognition and classification: statistical and structural pattern recognition, discriminant analysis and linear classifiers, clustering and unsupervised methods, kernel and ensemble classifiers, evaluation protocols and benchmarking, and handling of limited and imbalanced training data. Artificial intelligence and deep learning in image processing: convolutional and transformer architectures for vision, generative adversarial and diffusion models, transfer and self-supervised learning, deep learning for object recognition and segmentation, and AI-based medical image analysis. Image understanding and scene interpretation: object recognition and localisation, semantic scene analysis, domain-specific process modelling for image workflows, knowledge-driven interpretation, and integration of vision with reasoning. Three-dimensional imaging and immersive applications: 3D reconstruction from multiple views, depth estimation and stereoscopic vision, point cloud processing, augmented and virtual reality integration, and 3D modelling for medical and industrial imaging. Medical and biological image analysis: modality-specific processing, lesion detection and segmentation, registration and quantitative imaging, microscopy and histopathology analysis, and computer-aided diagnosis workflows. Big data and cloud-based image analytics: scalable and distributed image processing pipelines, cloud platforms for large-scale image workloads, management and indexing of large image repositories, and distributed pattern recognition architectures. Quantum approaches to image processing: quantum representations of image data, quantum algorithms for compression and transformation, quantum pattern recognition methods, and evaluation of quantum image analysis frameworks. Image security and forensics: steganography and steganalysis, watermarking and cryptographic image authentication, tamper detection and anti-forgery techniques, manipulated and synthetic image detection, and pattern recognition for security applications. Explainable and ethical artificial intelligence: interpretable models for image-based decisions, saliency and attribution methods, bias detection in image datasets and models, fairness and transparency in automated visual analysis, and ethical considerations in surveillance and medical imaging deployment.

name: International Journal of Information Security Engineering
scope: Information security governance and risk management: security strategy and programme design, risk identification, assessment, and treatment methodologies, information asset classification and ownership, security metrics and reporting to leadership, third-party and supply chain risk, and security investment and economics. Standards, compliance, and audit: implementation of information security management systems, control framework mapping and gap analysis, regulatory and data protection compliance, continuous compliance monitoring and automated control testing, audit evidence collection, and certification readiness. Security architecture and engineering: enterprise security architecture design, defence in depth and zero trust models, secure system and service design patterns, security service layers in distributed and service-oriented systems, segmentation and trust boundary design, and security in embedded and control system architectures. Identity and access management: role-based, attribute-based, and policy-based access control models, context-aware and adaptive authorisation, privileged access management, federated identity and single sign-on, identity lifecycle and joiner-mover-leaver processes, and entitlement review and certification. Applied cryptography in practice: selection and deployment of cryptographic primitives, key management lifecycle and hardware security modules, certificate and public key infrastructure operations, encryption of data at rest and in transit, cryptographic agility and post-quantum migration planning, and common implementation failures. Offensive security and penetration testing: penetration testing methodology and scoping, web and application security testing, injection and authentication flaw discovery, automated scanning and false positive reduction, red teaming and adversary emulation, and responsible disclosure and ethical frameworks. Vulnerability and threat management: vulnerability discovery, triage, and prioritisation, exploitability and severity scoring, patch management practice and effectiveness, threat intelligence collection and enrichment, open source and social media as intelligence sources, and vulnerability database and advisory analysis. Security operations and monitoring: security operations centre design and workflow, log collection, normalisation, and correlation, detection engineering and alert tuning, automation and orchestration of response, metrics for detection and response performance, and analyst workload and alert fatigue. Incident response and digital forensics: incident classification and escalation, containment, eradication, and recovery practice, disk, memory, and network forensics, evidence handling and chain of custody, cloud and mobile forensics, and post-incident review and organisational learning. Application and software security: secure development lifecycle integration, threat modelling methodologies, static and dynamic application security testing, dependency and software composition analysis, security in continuous delivery pipelines, and secure coding practice and developer enablement. Platform and infrastructure security: operating system hardening and baseline configuration, endpoint protection and detection, cloud security posture and misconfiguration, container and workload security, backup and recovery integrity, and secure administration practice. Data protection and privacy engineering: data discovery and classification, data loss prevention, anonymisation and pseudonymisation techniques, privacy impact assessment, retention and disposal practice, and cross-border data transfer controls. Human and organisational factors: security awareness and behaviour change, social engineering and phishing resistance, insider threat detection and management, security culture measurement, and usability of security controls.

name: International Journal of Land

name: International Journal of Landscape Planning and Architecture
scope: The journal welcomes contributions across the following topic areas: Landscape Planning & Assessment: land-use planning, zoning, environmental assessment, site analysis, master planning, strategic planning, and capacity evaluation at regional and urban scales Landscape Architecture & Design: design solutions, aesthetic principles, planting design, hardscape/softscape design, public spaces, recreational design, and visual resource management Ecological Landscape Design: biodiversity conservation, habitat restoration, native plantings, wildlife corridors, permaculture principles, and regenerative design practices Urban Green Infrastructure: green roofs, rain gardens, urban forests, greenways, stormwater management, tree canopy, green corridors, and ecosystem service provision Landscape Ecology: habitat fragmentation, connectivity analysis, species distribution, landscape metrics, ecological processes, and spatial pattern analysis Cultural Landscapes: heritage conservation, historical preservation, indigenous knowledge, cultural interpretation, sacred sites, and landscape identity management Landscape Management & Governance: management frameworks, adaptive management, stakeholder collaboration, policy mechanisms, and institutional approaches to landscape stewardship Landscape Performance & Resilience: climate adaptation strategies, post-occupancy evaluation, performance metrics, disaster preparedness, and assessment of design effectiveness Landscape Perception & Experience: user preferences, aesthetic appreciation, psychological well-being, sense of place, and human-nature connection in outdoor environments

name: International Journal of Membranes
scope: Membrane Materials : Polymeric, ceramic, and metallic membranes, thin-film and composite membranes, mixed-matrix and nanostructured membranes, graphene and carbon-based membranes, zeolite membranes, biopolymer membranes, ion exchange membranes, hydrophilic and hydrophobic membranes. Membrane Fabrication and Modification : Phase inversion, interfacial polymerization, electrospinning, sol-gel processing and sintering, hydrothermal zeolite growth, layer-by-layer assembly, surface functionalization, antifouling coatings, scale-up and manufacturing reproducibility. Membrane Processes : Microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse and forward osmosis, gas separation and vapor permeation, dialysis, electrodialysis, membrane distillation, pervaporation, membrane crystallization, membrane contactors, membrane extraction, membrane adsorption and chromatography, membrane bioreactors. Membrane Characterization : Morphology and structure, thickness and surface area, pore size and pore size distribution, surface charge, hydrophobicity, permeability, selectivity, flux, microscopy, spectroscopy, and imaging, mechanical, thermal, and chemical stability, service life. Fouling, Cleaning, and Operation : Fouling mechanisms and prediction, scaling and biofouling, antifouling strategies, cleaning protocols, chemical compatibility, performance monitoring, energy demand and operating cost. Membrane Applications : Water and wastewater treatment and reuse in municipal and industrial settings, seawater and brackish water desalination, food processing, biotechnology, pharmaceutical production, protein purification, virus removal, carbon dioxide capture, air purification, membrane reactors, fuel cells, batteries, blood filtration including hemodialysis and plasma separation, artificial organs, drug delivery. Modeling, Simulation, and Design : Membrane transport models, mass and heat transfer modeling, computational fluid dynamics, finite element analysis, molecular dynamics simulation, kinetic and reaction engineering models, multiscale and multiphysics modeling, model validation and optimization, sensitivity and uncertainty analysis, optimization algorithms, performance prediction, machine learning and artificial intelligence, module, spacer, process, and system design. Sustainability and Resource Recovery : Life cycle assessment of membrane systems, energy efficiency, membrane end-of-life and recycling, resource and nutrient recovery. The journal publishes original research articles, reviews, and communications that report novel and significant findings. Studies of biological membranes solely for cell biology or physiology are out of scope, but biomimetic and cell-derived membranes used in separation, drug delivery, or artificial organs are welcome. The journal serves researchers, academics, engineers, and students in membrane science and technology, along with professionals in water treatment, chemical processing, and pharmaceuticals.

name: International Journal of Metallurgy and Alloys
subject_areas: Structure and Physical Properties of Materials
Mine Safety and Protection of Mines
scope: Physical Metallurgy and Structure–Property Relationships: Research on microstructure, phase constitution, crystallography, defects, grain structure, anisotropy, heterogeneity, phase transformations, and the relationships between processing, structure, and mechanical or functional properties of metals and alloys. Mechanical Behavior of Metals and Alloys: Studies on strength, hardness, ductility, brittleness, fracture, fatigue, creep, wear, deformation, constitutive behavior, damage tolerance, and mechanical performance under different loading and temperature conditions. Alloy Design and Development: Research on ferrous and non-ferrous alloys, titanium alloys, aluminium alloys, nickel-based alloys, transition-metal alloys, shape-memory alloys, hydrogen-storage alloys, and advanced alloy systems, including composition–microstructure–property optimization. Steel and Iron Production Technology: Studies on ironmaking, steelmaking, continuous casting, hot rolling, electric arc furnaces, blast furnace–basic oxygen furnace routes, iron ore processing, sintering, crude steel production, and low-carbon pathways for steel manufacture. Powder Metallurgy and Sintering: Research on powder production, compaction, sintering, spark plasma sintering, mechanical alloying, powder-based composites, porosity control, densification, and microstructural development in powder-processed metallic materials. Casting and Solidification: Studies on solidification mechanisms, casting defects, hot tearing, segregation, grain refinement, precipitation, thermal gradients, phase evolution, and computational or experimental analysis of casting processes. Welding and Joining of Metals: Research on fusion welding, friction stir welding, gas tungsten arc welding, laser welding, electron-beam joining, dissimilar-metal joining, weld metallurgy, residual stress, distortion, microstructural evolution, and joint performance. Additive Manufacturing of Metals: Studies on laser powder bed fusion, electron-beam powder bed fusion, selective laser melting, directed-energy deposition, process–structure–property relationships, anisotropy, porosity, defects, residual stress, and post-processing of additively manufactured metals. Surface Engineering and Modification: Research on shot peening, laser texturing, surface structuring, coatings, electropolishing, micro-arc oxidation, surface morphology, wettability, adhesion, friction, wear resistance, and engineered metallic surfaces. Corrosion Science and Corrosion Protection: Studies on uniform, localized, intergranular, galvanic, molten-salt, and high-temperature corrosion; corrosion mechanisms; electrochemical behavior; protective coatings; corrosion-resistant alloys; and service-life improvement of metallic components. Metal Matrix Composites and Hybrid Materials: Research on metal matrix composites, hybrid composites, reinforcement mechanisms, interfacial bonding, tribological behavior, thermal stability, mechanical properties, and processing routes for advanced composite materials. Extractive Metallurgy and Metal Recovery: Studies on pyrometallurgy, hydrometallurgy, electrolysis, solvent extraction, bioleaching, biosorption, metal recovery from ores and secondary resources, precious-metal recovery, and purification of metallurgical feedstocks. Recycling, Waste Valorization, and Circular Metallurgy: Research on electronic-waste processing, recovery of critical and precious metals, metallurgical waste valorization, secondary raw materials, recycling of metallic waste, resource efficiency, and circular-economy approaches in metallurgy. High-Temperature Metallurgy and Thermochemical Processing: Studies on gas–solid reactions, reduction, oxidation, metallurgical coke, thermochemical kinetics, high-temperature phase stability, furnace processes, reaction mechanisms, and process optimization in extractive and physical metallurgy. Metallurgical Thermodynamics and Kinetics: Research on phase equilibria, diffusion, transformation kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, reaction mechanisms, kinetic analysis, process energetics, and computational prediction of metallurgical phenomena. Computational Metallurgy and Process Modelling: Studies using finite-element analysis, numerical simulation, artificial neural networks, machine learning, thermodynamic databases, process modeling, and other computational tools for predicting microstructure, performance, and metallurgical process behavior. Metals for Energy Applications: Research on metallic and alloy materials for batteries, hydrogen storage, fuel cells, electrodes, metal hydrides, high-temperature energy systems, renewable-energy infrastructure, and energy-conversion technologies. Biomedical Metals and Metallic Implants: Studies on biocompatible metals and alloys, corrosion and wear of implant materials, porous metallic implants, surface modification, biomechanical compatibility, nickel–titanium materials, and metallurgical design for biomedical applications. Mining, Mineral Processing, and Mine Safety: Research on mineral extraction, mining technology, mine automation, underground safety, ventilation, rockburst and gas-outburst prediction, mine dust, mineral-resource management, and technological approaches to safer and more sustainable mining. Sustainable and Emerging Metallurgical Technologies: Research on decarbonized metallurgy, hydrogen-based processing, renewable-energy integration, low-emission steelmaking, resource-efficient production, advanced manufacturing, digital metallurgy, and interdisciplinary technologies that improve metallurgical sustainability and performance.

name: International Journal of Mobile Computing Technology
scope: Mobile platforms and device architecture: smartphone, tablet, and wearable system architecture, mobile operating system design and platform evolution, foldable and novel form factors, sensor subsystems on mobile devices, and hardware–software co-optimisation for mobile targets. Mobile application engineering: native, hybrid, and cross-platform development frameworks, mobile architecture patterns and state management, integrated development environments and toolchains for mobile, testing and continuous delivery for mobile applications, app store release practice, and empirical studies of mobile codebases. Mobile user interface and experience: interaction design for small and touch-based displays, navigation and information architecture on mobile, accessibility and assistive interaction, context-aware and adaptive interfaces, and user studies of mobile application usage. Mobile cloud computing: offloading architectures and partitioning decisions, mobile backend design and synchronisation, cloud service integration and vendor platform comparison, application migration to cloud-backed models, offline-first and intermittent connectivity design, and cost and performance trade-offs. Mobile edge computing: task offloading algorithms and scheduling, latency-sensitive application support, edge caching and content placement, resource allocation across device, edge, and cloud tiers, ultra-reliable low-latency application design, and energy–latency trade-off analysis. On-device intelligence: model compression and quantisation for mobile inference, neural processing unit utilisation, federated and on-device learning, privacy-preserving mobile analytics, and benchmarking of mobile machine learning workloads. Mobile device management and enterprise mobility: enterprise device enrolment and provisioning, policy and permission management, remote monitoring and configuration, containerisation and work profile separation, bring-your-own-device architectures, and compliance in managed fleets. Positioning, localisation, and context sensing: indoor positioning using ultra-wideband, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth, sensor fusion for localisation, activity and context recognition from device sensors, map matching and trajectory reconstruction, and accuracy characterisation of positioning methods. Mobile security and privacy: application permission models and their misuse, mobile malware detection, secure storage and key handling on devices, platform sandboxing and integrity mechanisms, tracking and fingerprinting of mobile users, and privacy regulation compliance in mobile applications. Energy, performance, and resource management: battery modelling and energy profiling of applications, thermal behaviour and throttling, background execution and scheduling policies, memory and storage constraints, and performance measurement methodology on mobile devices. Mobile and pervasive applications: mobile health and fitness systems, mobile payment and commerce applications, mobile learning platforms, participatory and crowd sensing, location-based services, and augmented reality on mobile devices. In-vehicle and transport computing: infotainment and driver interface systems, in-vehicle networks and electronic control unit software, smartphone integration with vehicle platforms, mobility service applications, and computing for connected vehicle deployment.

name: International Journal of Mechanics and Design
subject_areas: Analysis and concept of machine and structural components
Quantitative Nondestructive Evaluation with Computational Inverse Methods
scope: Continuum Mechanics and Material Behavior : Strain hardening, Bauschinger effect, homogenization, microstructure of carbon steels, constitutive modeling. Wear of Carbon Steels : Mild and severe wear, abrasion, wear mapping, wear modeling. Fluid Mechanics and Computational Methods : Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis, meshless methods, finite element method, airflow analysis. Multibody Dynamics : Vehicle dynamics, tire models, multibody simulation software, research trends in multibody systems. Experimental Stress Analysis : Stress concentration, stress analysis of cylinders, stresses in extruded and pressed metal parts, thermal stress, analytical and experimental validation methods. Analysis and Design of Machine and Structural Components : Machine tool structures, cast iron components, topological optimization, friction stir welding, damping, composite and hybrid materials, experimental modal analysis. Gas Turbines : Compressor and turbine blade design, blade cooling, combustion, hydrogen and natural gas fuels, nitrogen oxide emission control, combined cycle power stations, enthalpy analysis. Biomechanics : Mechanics of biological tissues, orthopedic implant design, human movement analysis. Quantitative Nondestructive Evaluation with Computational Inverse Methods : Eddy current modeling and inversion, pulsed eddy current testing, thin skin theory, reciprocity formulas, elastic wave propagation, dynamic response analysis, finite element and neural network–based inverse methods. The journal publishes original research articles, review articles, case studies, and short communications. Quantum physics, and materials or energy studies with no mechanical analysis or design component, are out of scope. The journal serves mechanical, structural, and aerospace engineers, design and NDE specialists, researchers, and graduate students.

name: International Journal of Microelectronics and Digital Integrated Circuits
subject_areas: Audio-Amplifiers, FM Radios, Logic Blocks, and Regulators
scope: Microelectronic Devices and Technologies: Semiconductor devices, MOSFETs, CMOS devices, BJTs, FinFETs, gate-all-around transistors, tunnel FETs, nanoscale devices, device modelling, fabrication technologies, scaling effects, and emerging semiconductor structures. Digital Integrated Circuit Design: Combinational and sequential circuits, arithmetic circuits, logic families, finite-state machines, digital architectures, low-power digital design, clocking techniques, timing optimization, and high-speed digital circuits. Analog Integrated Circuits: Operational amplifiers, comparators, voltage and current references, regulators, oscillators, active filters, amplifiers, analog signal-conditioning circuits, current mirrors, and analog interface circuits. Mixed-Signal Integrated Circuits: Analog-to-digital converters, digital-to-analog converters, phase-locked loops, data converters, mixed-signal interfaces, clock and data recovery, mixed-signal modelling, and mixed-signal verification. RF and Microwave Integrated Circuits: RF amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, mixers, oscillators, frequency synthesizers, RF front ends, wireless transceivers, microwave integrated circuits, millimeter-wave circuits, and RF CMOS technologies. VLSI Design and Architecture: VLSI architectures, processor design, application-specific integrated circuits, system-level design, low-power architectures, high-performance circuits, multicore architectures, and reconfigurable systems. Electronic Design Automation: Circuit simulation, logic synthesis, placement and routing, static timing analysis, physical verification, layout automation, power analysis, design optimization, and computer-aided integrated circuit design. Hardware Description Languages and RTL Design: VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog, RTL modelling, behavioral modelling, register-transfer design, synthesizable coding, hardware abstraction, and digital design methodologies. High-Level Synthesis and Hardware Design Automation: C/C++/SystemC-based hardware design, high-level synthesis, design-space exploration, hardware/software partitioning, automated RTL generation, and system-level optimization. Functional and Formal Verification: Functional verification, formal verification, assertion-based verification, equivalence checking, static analysis, coverage-driven verification, RTL linting, simulation-based verification, and verification methodologies. Power Supplies and Industrial Conversion: Switched-mode power supplies, uninterruptible power supplies, industrial converters, telecom power supplies, server power supplies, welding power supplies, induction heating, and regulated power systems. Pathology and Pathophysiology of Infection : Histopathology, cellular responses, immunopathology, inflammation, necrosis and apoptosis, viral tropism and latency, microbial clearance. Molecular Biology and Genetics of Infectious Agents : Genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, metagenomics, phylogenetics, pathogen evolution, horizontal gene transfer, pathogenicity islands, CRISPR/Cas systems, resistance genes, viral replication. Environmental and atmospheric photochemistry: photolysis of pollutants in air and water, light-induced transformation of contaminants, photodegradation kinetics and transformation products, solar disinfection, and photochemical processes in natural waters.

Polymer Nanotechnology: Research on polymer nanoparticles, nanofibers, nanogels, nano- and microparticles, polymer–nanomaterial interfaces, nanostructured polymers, functional nanocomposites, and nanoscale approaches to polymer design and applications. Hydrogels and Smart Polymers: Studies on hydrogels, stimuli-responsive polymers, shape-memory polymers, self-healing polymers, pH- and temperature-responsive systems, mucoadhesive polymers, and smart materials for biomedical, industrial, and environmental applications. Biomedical and Pharmaceutical Polymers: Research on polymeric biomaterials, drug-delivery systems, tissue-engineering scaffolds, implants, controlled release, insulin delivery, mucoadhesive systems, biocompatibility, biodegradable carriers, and polymer-based medical technologies. Polymer Blends, Alloys, and Compatibilization: Studies on miscibility, phase behavior, morphology, compatibilizers, interfacial adhesion, thermodynamic interactions, processing, and performance of polymer blends and polymer alloys. Polymer Mechanics and Engineering Properties: Research on tensile, impact, fatigue, fracture, creep, viscoelastic, thermal, barrier, electrical, optical, and tribological properties of polymers and polymer-based materials. Polymer Degradation, Stability, and Aging: Studies on thermal, oxidative, photochemical, hydrolytic, environmental, and mechanical degradation, stabilization, weathering, service-life prediction, and durability of polymeric materials. Polymer Recycling and Circular Materials: Research on mechanical recycling, chemical recycling, hydrolysis, alcoholysis, depolymerization, dry-heat processes, enzymatic recycling, sorting, recovery, upcycling, reuse, and circular-economy approaches to polymer waste. Sustainable and Green Polymer Engineering: Studies on renewable feedstocks, bio-based polymers, low-carbon processing, solvent reduction, green synthesis, degradable plastics, resource efficiency, life-cycle considerations, and environmentally responsible polymer technologies. Polymer Membranes and Separation Technologies: Research on polymeric membranes for gas separation, water purification, filtration, desalination, dialysis, fuel cells, and industrial separations, including membrane fabrication, transport behavior, fouling, durability, and performance optimization. Coatings, Adhesives, Films, and Surface Engineering: Studies on polymer coatings, thin films, adhesives, sealants, barrier films, packaging films, surface modification, corrosion protection, functional surfaces, and performance of polymeric interfaces. Elastomers, Rubbers, and Thermoplastic Elastomers: Research on natural and synthetic rubbers, elastomer blends, vulcanization, reinforcement, aging, mechanical behavior, thermoplastic elastomers, and applications in engineering, automotive, biomedical, and industrial systems. Polymer Applications in Energy and Electronics: Studies on conducting polymers, dielectric polymers, polymer electrolytes, energy-storage materials, fuel-cell membranes, flexible electronics, sensors, photovoltaic materials, and polymer systems for energy and electronic devices. Computational and Modeling Approaches in Polymer Science: Research using molecular dynamics, finite-element methods, computational chemistry, multiscale modeling, machine learning, process simulation, and data-driven methods to predict polymer structure, properties, processing, and performance. Emerging and Interdisciplinary Polymer Technologies: Research integrating polymer science with biotechnology, nanotechnology, materials engineering, environmental science, chemical engineering, medicine, electronics, and manufacturing where polymer science or polymer engineering forms the central scientific contribution.

RF MEMS and Reconfigurable RF Devices: RF MEMS switches, tunable capacitors, microresonators, MEMS phase shifters, reconfigurable filters, and miniaturized RF microsystems. RF Measurements and Instrumentation: Spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, RF power meters, signal generators, impedance analyzers, S-parameter measurement, calibration, and high-frequency test methodologies. RF Signal Processing: RF sampling, filtering, modulation recognition, interference suppression, channel estimation, signal classification, spectrum analysis, and adaptive RF signal processing. RF for Biomedical and Healthcare Applications: RF-enabled health monitoring, wireless medical sensors, body-area communication, implant communication, RF exposure studies, and healthcare information systems. RF for Smart Cities and Industrial Systems: Industrial wireless systems, machine communication, remote monitoring, smart infrastructure, localization, asset tracking, and RF-enabled automation. Satellite and Space RF Technologies: Satellite RF links, ground-station RF systems, RF payloads, telemetry, tracking and command, satellite navigation, and space communication. Artificial Intelligence in RF Engineering: Machine learning for RF signal classification, antenna optimization, spectrum management, anomaly detection, channel modelling, adaptive radios, and AI-assisted RF system design. Quantum RF and Emerging Radio Technologies: Quantum RF sensing, quantum-enhanced RF systems, ultra-low-noise amplification, quantum-secure communication, photonic-RF integration, and next-generation RF technologies. Recent IJRFI publications have already explored quantum RF concepts, supporting inclusion of this area.
