ASIC Design: Application-specific integrated circuits, custom digital architectures, ASIC design flow, logic synthesis, physical implementation, and domain-specific hardware. Hardware Description Languages: Verilog, VHDL, SystemVerilog, RTL modelling, behavioral modelling, synthesizable design, and hardware abstraction. RTL Design and Optimization: Register-transfer-level design, logic minimization, datapath optimization, control-path design, resource sharing, and synthesis-aware RTL coding. Electronic Design Automation: Logic synthesis, placement and routing, floorplanning, static timing analysis, power analysis, design-rule checking, layout-versus-schematic verification, and automated design optimization. Physical Design: Floorplanning, placement, routing, clock-tree synthesis, congestion reduction, parasitic extraction, signal integrity, timing closure, and power-grid design. VLSI Testing and Design for Testability: Scan design, automatic test-pattern generation, built-in self-test, fault modelling, fault simulation, test compression, memory testing, and DFT-compatible architectures. Fault-Tolerant VLSI: Error detection and correction, timing-error tolerance, redundancy, resilient circuit architectures, radiation tolerance, soft-error mitigation, and reliable VLSI systems. Formal and Functional Verification: Simulation, equivalence checking, assertion-based verification, formal verification, coverage analysis, verification environments, and hardware validation. System-on-Chip Design: SoC architecture, IP integration, bus systems, embedded processors, hardware accelerators, heterogeneous SoCs, and system-level integration. Multiprocessor System-on-Chip: MPSoC architectures, multicore processing, interprocessor communication, shared-memory systems, task mapping, and hardware-software co-design. Network-on-Chip: NoC architectures, routing, switching, topology design, congestion management, fault tolerance, quality of service, and scalable on-chip communication. Embedded VLSI Systems: Embedded processors, hardware-software integration, real-time hardware, embedded accelerators, sensor nodes, and application-specific VLSI platforms. Digital Signal Processing Hardware: FIR and IIR filters, FFT architectures, image-processing hardware, audio-processing systems, communication signal processing, and DSP accelerators. Recent IJVCDT work on underwater wireless sensor-node digital filters fits this area well. Cryptographic Hardware: AES, RSA, ECC, hash architectures, cryptographic accelerators, secure hardware, FPGA-based encryption, and high-throughput security implementations. Recent IJVCDT work includes optimized FPGA-based AES hardware. Hardware Security: Hardware Trojans, physically unclonable functions, side-channel resistance, secure boot, trusted hardware, secure IC design, and tamper-resistant circuits. Memory Design: SRAM, DRAM, cache memories, register files, low-power memories, nonvolatile memories, memory controllers, and emerging memory architectures. AI and Machine-Learning Hardware: Neural processing units, AI accelerators, edge-AI hardware, CNN accelerators, hardware-efficient neural networks, and machine-learning-specific architectures. Neuromorphic Computing: Spiking neural networks, brain-inspired circuits, event-driven processing, neuromorphic architectures, and low-power intelligent hardware. Spintronic and Post-CMOS Logic: Magnetic tunnel junctions, spin-transfer torque, spin-orbit torque, nonvolatile logic, spintronic circuits, and beyond-CMOS computing. This is already represented in recent IJVCDT publications. Semiconductor Devices for VLSI: FinFETs, gate-all-around transistors, nanoscale MOSFETs, silicon-on-insulator devices, emerging transistor technologies, and device-circuit interaction. Three-Dimensional ICs and Chiplets: 2.5D/3D integration, through-silicon vias, die stacking, chiplets, heterogeneous integration, advanced packaging, and thermal management. VLSI for IoT and Sensor Nodes: Ultra-low-power hardware, embedded sensors, wireless sensor nodes, wearable electronics, IoT edge devices, and application-specific low-power circuits. Communication VLSI: Baseband processors, wireless communication hardware, channel coding, modulation hardware, MIMO architectures, RF-digital interfaces, and communication accelerators. Image and Video Processing Hardware: Image filters, object detection hardware, video codecs, vision accelerators, image enhancement circuits, and real-time imaging architectures. Biomedical VLSI: Implantable electronics, biosignal acquisition, wearable hardware, medical sensor interfaces, low-power biomedical circuits, and health-monitoring systems. Reliability and Process Variation: Process-voltage-temperature variation, aging, electromigration, timing variation, yield analysis, thermal effects, and reliability-aware design. Emerging VLSI Technologies: Quantum-inspired hardware, photonic computing, memristor-based logic, in-memory computing, flexible integrated circuits, neuromorphic devices, and next-generation semiconductor architectures.

name: International Journal of Virus Studies
scope: Viral Pathogenesis : Mechanisms of virus-induced pathology, tissue tropism, viral persistence and latency, determinants of disease severity, animal models of infection. Virus–Host Interactions and Molecular Virology : Viral entry, replication, and assembly, host and restriction factors, subversion of cellular pathways, reverse genetics, viral protein structure and function, host targets for therapy. Viral Genomics, Evolution, and Phylogenetics : Viral genome sequencing and annotation, mutation and recombination, quasispecies dynamics, phylogenetic analysis, evolutionary models, virus classification. Viral Bioinformatics : Computational analysis of viral genomes, protein structure prediction, variant calling, genomic epidemiology pipelines, modeling of viral spread and evolution. Immunology of Viral Infections : Innate and adaptive antiviral immunity, correlates of protection, immune evasion, immunopathology, immunotherapeutic approaches. Viral Diagnostics : Molecular assays, serology, antigen and point-of-care tests, sequencing-based diagnostics, viral load quantification, assay validation and performance. Antiviral Therapeutics : Antiviral drug discovery and development, resistance to antivirals, monoclonal antibody therapy, preclinical and clinical evaluation, treatment outcomes. Viral Vaccinology : Traditional and novel vaccine platforms, vaccine design, immunogenicity, efficacy and effectiveness, vaccine safety, duration of vaccine-induced protection. Viral Epidemiology and Surveillance : Prevalence, incidence, and transmission dynamics, molecular and genomic epidemiology, outbreak detection, sentinel and wastewater surveillance, epidemiological modeling. Zoonotic, Emerging, and Re-emerging Viruses : Spillover from animal reservoirs, virus ecology in wildlife and livestock, drivers of emergence, risk assessment, pandemic preparedness and response, One Health approaches. The journal publishes original research articles, reviews, short communications, and letters to the editor, together with peer-reviewed special issues, supplements, and conference proceedings. Bacterial, fungal, and parasitic disease studies with no viral component are out of scope. The journal serves virologists, infectious disease clinicians, immunologists, epidemiologists, vaccine and antiviral developers, and public health specialists.

name: International Journal of Women’s Health Nursing And Practices
scope: The journal welcomes contributions across the following topic areas: Primary Health Care for Women: primary healthcare delivery models and accessibility, chronic disease management in women, comorbidity assessment and holistic care, eHealth and digital health technologies, risk factor assessment and health screening, family health and interdisciplinary care, health promotion and disease prevention in women, geriatric assessment and primary care in aging women, home care and long-term care coordination, and outcomes in primary women's health Reproductive Health & Family Planning: reproductive health across the lifespan, fertility and infertility assessment and support, family planning and contraceptive services, pregnancy care and perinatal outcomes, childbirth and obstetric nursing, postpartum recovery and postnatal care, puerperium and puerperal complications, quality of maternal and infant care, emotional and psychological aspects of reproduction, and reproductive health in COVID-19 and pandemic contexts Gynecological Health & Hysterectomy: gynecological assessment and diagnosis, abnormal uterine bleeding evaluation and treatment, myomas and benign gynecological conditions, endometrial and cervical cancer screening and prevention, ovarian cancer assessment and surveillance, pelvic organ prolapse and pelvic floor dysfunction, hysterectomy decision-making and outcomes, vaginal versus abdominal approaches, post-hysterectomy adjustment and quality of life, and long-term outcomes following hysterectomy Menopausal & Geriatric Gynecology: menopause and menopausal transition assessment, menopausal symptom management and hormone therapy, hot flashes and night sweats intervention, vaginal and urogenital atrophy and treatment, bone health and osteoporosis prevention in menopause, cardiovascular risk in menopausal women, sexual health and intimacy in menopause, geriatric gynecology and aging-related changes, post-menopausal health maintenance, and quality of life and well-being in menopause and beyond Oophorectomy & Surgical Menopause: prophylactic bilateral oophorectomy decision-making, surgical versus natural menopause outcomes, estrogen deficiency and associated changes, hormone replacement therapy and alternatives, cardiovascular and bone health post-oophorectomy, psychological and sexual adjustment after oophorectomy, long-term mortality and morbidity outcomes, and nursing support through surgical transitions Women's Mental & Emotional Health: postpartum and perinatal mood disorders, depression and anxiety screening and treatment, mood disorders and hormonal transitions, emotional adjustment to reproductive events, psychological trauma and abuse in women's lives, grief and bereavement in women, stress management and coping strategies, psychopharmacology in women, and mental health outcomes and well-being Healthcare Disparities & Health Equity: health and healthcare inequalities in women, determinants of health and social factors, marginalized and vulnerable women's populations, racial and ethnic health disparities, cultural competence and culturally sensitive care, immigration and refugee women's health, LGBTQ+ women's health and affirming care, economic and social barriers to care, intervention-generated inequalities, and strategies to reduce disparities Transcultural & Community-Centered Nursing: transcultural nursing competence and cultural humility, cross-cultural care delivery and communication, cultural diversity and health beliefs, health attitudes and health behaviors across cultures, ethnic and cultural values in women's health, culturally tailored health promotion, community health worker training and support, partnership with community organizations, and health literacy and patient education across cultures Community Health & Health Workforce: lay health workers and community health worker training, health workforce roles and scope of practice, global health and population health initiatives, community-based health promotion, health advocacy and patient empowerment, health services research and policy, universal healthcare systems and access, health policy impact and implementation, and equity and efficiency in healthcare delivery Women's Health Services & Delivery Models: concierge medicine and membership-based models, transitions to alternative healthcare delivery, luxury and retainer medicine in women's health, primary care integration and coordination, telemedicine and telehealth in women's health, hospital-based and community-based services, ambulatory and outpatient care models, integrated mental and physical health, and outcomes and patient satisfaction in service delivery Women's Health Across Ages & Conditions: adolescent girls' health and development, reproductive-age women's health, aging and geriatric women's health, women with disabilities and chronic conditions, special populations and vulnerable groups, occupational and environmental health for women, lifestyle medicine and preventive health, health maintenance and wellness promotion, and comprehensive and person-centered care approaches

name: International Journal of Water Resources Engineering
subject_areas: Nexus of water, energy, and agricultural systems
Infrastructure to uncertain and evolving environments
scope: Hydrology and catchment processes: rainfall–runoff modelling, water balance and evapotranspiration, snowmelt and glacial hydrology, infiltration and soil moisture dynamics, hydrological model calibration and uncertainty, and remote sensing and GIS applications in hydrology. Hydrodynamics and computational hydraulics: open channel and pressurised flow, turbulence and mixing processes, numerical modelling with one-, two-, and three-dimensional schemes, physical hydraulic modelling and scaling, hydraulic transients, and validation against field and laboratory data. River engineering and sediment dynamics: fluvial geomorphology and channel evolution, sediment transport and scour, river training and bank protection, dredging and channel maintenance, floodplain connectivity, and reservoir sedimentation and flushing. River restoration and environmental hydraulics: ecological restoration of degraded river systems, environmental and minimum flow requirements, fish passage and habitat hydraulics, riparian and wetland rehabilitation, and thermal and water quality dynamics in flowing waters. Hydropower engineering: run-of-river and storage scheme design, turbine selection and performance, penstock and surge system analysis, small and micro-hydropower systems, pumped storage operation, and integration of hydropower with variable renewable generation. Dams, reservoirs, and hydraulic structures: dam design, safety, and surveillance, spillway and energy dissipation design, gates, weirs, and control structures, reservoir operation and optimisation, multipurpose reservoir systems, and rehabilitation of ageing hydraulic infrastructure. Flood hydrology and management: flood frequency analysis, hydrodynamic flood inundation modelling, dam break and breach analysis, flood forecasting and early warning, structural and non-structural mitigation measures, and floodplain mapping and risk assessment. Groundwater and surface water interaction: aquifer recharge and discharge processes, baseflow contribution to rivers, conjunctive use of surface and groundwater, seepage through and beneath hydraulic structures, and modelling of coupled systems. Irrigation and conveyance hydraulics: canal design and regulation, conveyance losses and lining performance, flow measurement structures, pumping and lift systems, and hydraulic efficiency of distribution networks. Water conservation and climate adaptation: demand reduction and efficiency measures, rainwater harvesting and artificial recharge, drought hydrology and low-flow analysis, climate change impacts on catchment yield and extremes, and adaptation of water infrastructure to changing hydrological regimes. Instrumentation, monitoring, and data-driven methods: streamflow and sediment gauging, remote sensing of water bodies, sensor networks and telemetry, hydroinformatics, and machine learning applications in hydrological and hydraulic prediction.

name: International Journal of Wireless Security and Networks
scope: Wireless threats: Wireless sensor network, security threat, security issues, security attacks, Wireless networks, Data security, Information security, Principal component analysis, Internet, Mobile computing, Secure storage, Computer networks, Communication system security, Information analysis, Internet security, wireless network media, mobile storage, cable network environment, primary components analysis. Signal-hiding: Differential power analysis, DPA,dual-rail logic styles, hardware security, information-theoretic metrics, randomization,side-channel signal hiding, worst-case security evaluation, noise emulation, masking side-channel attacks, algorithmic countermeasures, amplitude randomization techniques, masking security proofs,side-channel information leakage,side-channel signal hiding, signal hiding countermeasures, security tradeoff. Wireless vulnerabilities: Wireless security, group decision support, collaborative, knowledge management, vulnerability scan wireless networks, Information security, Knowledge management, Communication system security, Collaboration, Risk management, Data Security, Network servers, Authorization, and Computer security. Securing wireless transmissions: Data transmission, wireless mesh networks, wireless data dissemination, emergency services broadcasting, military communication, reliable data dissemination, wireless network, security attacks, network dynamics, hand-held receivers coding, security key management, mobile devices Relays, Wireless communication, Communication system security, Receivers, Network coding, Authentication. Network auditing: Neural networks, auditing, audit risk assessment, real-world cases, Intelligent networks, Artificial neural networks, Marketing and sales, Risk management, Training data, Chromium, Law, Legal factors, and Information systems. Wireless public key infrastructure: Wireless networks, Public key, Public key cryptography, Communication system security, Elliptic curve cryptography, Computer networks, Communication system control, Communication system operations, and management, Computer network management, Business communication computer networks, public key cryptography, radiocommunication, security of data, telecommunication security. Electromagnetic shielding: Matrix multiplication approach, multiple cylindrical shells, Gaussian elimination, Helmholtz equations, boundary equations, low-frequency electromagnetic shielding, low-frequency electromagnetic scattering transients, electromagnetic shielding, electromagnetic fields, conducting bodies, electromagnetic interference.

name: Journal of Banking and Insurance Law
subject_areas: Alternative Dispute Resolution and Legal Services
scope: Banking Law and Financial Regulation: Research on laws, regulations, and regulatory institutions governing banks and financial institutions, including licensing, prudential regulation, governance, compliance, supervision, and evolving legal standards affecting the banking sector. Banking Transactions and Customer Relations: Studies on deposits, lending, guarantees, letters of credit, negotiable instruments, electronic banking, banker–customer relationships, duties of banks, confidentiality, customer protection, and liability arising from banking transactions. Debt Recovery and Non-Performing Assets: Research on recovery of debts, non-performing assets, loan restructuring, enforcement mechanisms, Debt Recovery Tribunals, creditor remedies, asset recovery, and legal strategies for resolution of stressed financial assets. Securitization and Enforcement of Security Interests: Studies on securitization, secured lending, asset reconstruction companies, security interests, enforcement against secured assets, security receipts, and legal frameworks governing reconstruction of financial assets. Insolvency, Bankruptcy, and Creditor Rights: Research on insolvency and bankruptcy law as it affects banks, insurers, financial institutions, borrowers, creditors, guarantors, and secured lenders, including resolution, liquidation, restructuring, and creditor-priority issues. Insurance Law and Regulation: Studies on legal and regulatory frameworks governing life, health, general, motor, property, liability, and other forms of insurance, including licensing, policy interpretation, claims, exclusions, insurer obligations, and regulatory compliance. Insurance Contracts and Claims Management: Research on formation and interpretation of insurance contracts, disclosure obligations, utmost good faith, insurable interest, indemnity, subrogation, claims settlement, repudiation, fraud, and disputes between insurers and policyholders. Consumer Protection in Banking and Insurance: Examination of consumer rights, unfair practices, mis-selling, transparency, disclosure, grievance redressal, compensation, ombudsman mechanisms, digital-service complaints, and judicial or regulatory remedies in banking and insurance. Financial Consumer Protection and Ombudsman Mechanisms: Research on complaint-resolution systems, banking and insurance ombudsman frameworks, regulatory grievance mechanisms, customer redressal, financial literacy, and access to effective remedies. Digital Banking, FinTech, and Emerging Financial Technologies: Studies on internet and mobile banking, digital payments, FinTech, artificial intelligence, blockchain, open banking, automated decision-making, RegTech, digital lending, and the legal implications of technology-driven financial services. Cybersecurity, Data Protection, and Financial Fraud: Research on cybercrime affecting banks and insurers, data breaches, identity theft, digital fraud, payment fraud, cybersecurity obligations, privacy, electronic evidence, authentication, and institutional liability for digital-security failures. Financial Crime, Anti-Money Laundering, and Compliance: Studies on money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, suspicious transactions, customer due diligence, Know Your Customer requirements, beneficial ownership, financial intelligence, sanctions compliance, and institutional accountability. Banking and Insurance Taxation: Research on taxation affecting banks, insurers, financial products, transactions, investments, premiums, financial services, and regulatory reporting, including the interaction between tax law and financial-sector operations. Corporate Governance and Risk Management in Financial Institutions: Studies on board responsibilities, internal controls, compliance systems, fiduciary duties, risk governance, executive accountability, capital adequacy, operational risk, and governance standards applicable to banks and insurers. Dispute Resolution in Banking and Insurance: Research on litigation, arbitration, mediation, conciliation, Lok Adalats, tribunals, ombudsman proceedings, and other dispute-resolution mechanisms involving banks, insurers, borrowers, policyholders, and financial institutions. International and Comparative Banking and Insurance Law: Comparative research on banking supervision, insurance regulation, cross-border financial services, international standards, foreign investment, transnational transactions, and regulatory approaches across jurisdictions. Indian Banking and Insurance Law and Policy: Research on Indian banking and insurance legislation, regulatory developments, judicial decisions, Reserve Bank of India and Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India frameworks, financial-sector reforms, and comparative studies relevant to the Indian legal and regulatory environment. The journal welcomes doctrinal, empirical, comparative, and interdisciplinary scholarship with a clear connection to banking or insurance law.

name: Journal of Corporate Governance and International Business Law
scope: Corporate Governance and Board Accountability: Research on governance structures, board composition, director duties, board independence, accountability, transparency, fiduciary responsibilities, executive oversight, and the effectiveness of corporate decision-making mechanisms. International Business Law and Cross-Border Transactions: Studies on the legal frameworks governing international trade and business operations, cross-border contracts, foreign investment, international commercial transactions, multinational enterprises, and regulatory issues affecting companies operating across jurisdictions. Corporate Compliance and Regulatory Governance: Research on corporate compliance systems, statutory obligations, internal controls, regulatory enforcement, disclosure requirements, risk management, corporate investigations, and mechanisms for ensuring responsible business conduct. Mergers, Acquisitions, and Corporate Restructuring: Studies on mergers, acquisitions, amalgamations, takeovers, corporate restructuring, joint ventures, due diligence, regulatory approvals, shareholder protection, and governance challenges arising from corporate combinations. Multinational Enterprises and Subsidiary Governance: Research on governance and legal issues affecting multinational corporations, including subsidiary mandates, parent–subsidiary relationships, cross-border control, corporate group structures, transfer of authority, and accountability within multinational enterprises. Shareholder and Stakeholder Rights: Studies on shareholder protection, minority rights, institutional investors, stakeholder participation, voting rights, shareholder activism, investor engagement, and the balancing of shareholder and broader stakeholder interests in corporate governance. Corporate Social Responsibility and ESG Governance: Research on corporate social responsibility, environmental, social and governance practices, sustainability reporting, responsible investment, corporate citizenship, non-financial disclosure, climate-related governance, and legal accountability for corporate sustainability commitments. Business Ethics and Corporate Responsibility: Studies on ethical decision-making, corporate culture, integrity, conflicts of interest, whistleblowing, anti-corruption practices, ethical leadership, philanthropy, and the relationship between business ethics and corporate governance. Corporate Groups and Ownership Structures: Research on family-owned enterprises, state-owned enterprises, widely held corporations, holding companies, business groups, ownership concentration, controlling shareholders, agency conflicts, and governance challenges arising from complex corporate structures. Corporate Finance and Governance: Studies on the relationship between corporate governance and capital structure, investment decisions, financial performance, dividend policy, financing arrangements, institutional investment, and governance mechanisms influencing firm value. Securities Regulation and Corporate Disclosure: Research on listed-company obligations, securities regulation, market disclosure, financial and non-financial reporting, insider trading, market misconduct, investor protection, and governance requirements applicable to publicly traded companies. Insolvency, Corporate Distress, and Governance: Studies on corporate insolvency, restructuring, creditor rights, board duties during financial distress, business rescue, liquidation, insolvency governance, and the accountability of directors and management in financially distressed companies. Competition Law and International Business: Research on competition regulation, anti-competitive agreements, abuse of dominance, merger control, market concentration, cross-border competition issues, and the interaction between corporate strategy and competition law. Foreign Investment and International Corporate Regulation: Studies on foreign direct investment, investment screening, multinational investment structures, regulatory approvals, bilateral investment frameworks, corporate establishment, and legal risks associated with international business expansion. Technology, Digital Business, and Corporate Governance: Research on artificial intelligence, digital platforms, blockchain, cybersecurity, data governance, automated decision-making, digital transformation, and emerging governance and accountability issues created by technology-driven business models. Corporate Dispute Resolution and International Commercial Arbitration: Studies on corporate litigation, shareholder disputes, contractual disputes, international commercial arbitration, mediation, conciliation, enforcement of arbitral awards, and dispute-resolution mechanisms relevant to international business. Comparative and International Corporate Governance: Comparative research on governance models, board systems, shareholder protection, regulatory approaches, corporate accountability, sustainability governance, and international best practices across different jurisdictions. Indian Corporate Governance and International Business Regulation: Research on Indian company law, corporate governance standards, securities regulation, foreign investment rules, judicial and regulatory developments, and reforms affecting Indian companies engaged in domestic and international business. Comparative and interdisciplinary scholarship is welcome where corporate governance or international business law forms the central contribution.

name: Journal of Constitutional Law and Jurisprudence
subject_areas: The Constitutional Jurisprudence-Concept, influence, and significance
Legislature in a neo-political trend and Constitutional mandate
scope: Constitutional Jurisprudence and Legal Theory: Research on constitutionalism, constitutional interpretation, legal reasoning, natural law, analytical and sociological jurisprudence, legal institutions, rule of law, and the relationship between law, society, and the State. Fundamental Rights and Constitutional Freedoms: Studies on equality, non-discrimination, freedom of speech and expression, association, assembly, movement, residence, profession, religious freedom, cultural and educational rights, privacy, dignity, and other constitutionally protected freedoms. Constitutional Remedies and Judicial Review: Research on writ jurisdiction, constitutional remedies, judicial review, constitutional challenges to legislation and executive action, standards of review, enforceability of rights, and the role of courts in protecting constitutional governance. Basic Structure and Constitutional Amendments: Studies on constitutional amendment powers, the basic structure doctrine, limits on constituent power, constitutional identity, amendment jurisprudence, and judicial scrutiny of constitutional changes. Directive Principles and Welfare State: Research on the constitutional significance and implementation of Directive Principles of State Policy, social and economic welfare, public policy, distributive justice, state responsibility, and the evolving role of the welfare state. Social Justice, Gender Justice, and Minority Rights: Studies on affirmative action, reservation, caste discrimination, gender equality, LGBTQ+ rights, minority protections, education, healthcare, social inclusion, and constitutional responses to structural disadvantage. Legislature, Executive, and Constitutional Governance: Research on legislative powers, executive authority, delegated legislation, accountability, separation of powers, checks and balances, parliamentary practices, constitutional conventions, and institutional relationships among organs of government. Judicial Independence and Constitutional Adjudication: Studies on judicial independence, appointments, accountability, judicial activism, judicial restraint, constitutional interpretation, reservation in the judiciary, and the institutional role of courts in a constitutional democracy. Federalism and Centre–State Relations: Research on legislative and administrative relations between different levels of government, fiscal federalism, intergovernmental disputes, emergency powers, cooperative and competitive federalism, and constitutional distribution of powers. Constitutional Democracy and Electoral Governance: Studies on popular sovereignty, representative democracy, elections, political participation, electoral reform, majority rule, minority rights, political accountability, campaign regulation, and constitutional safeguards against arbitrary governance. Religion, Secularism, and Constitutional Politics: Research on freedom of religion, secularism, religious institutions, personal laws, state regulation of religion, constitutional morality, religious politics, and tensions between religious freedom and other fundamental rights. Local Self-Government and Decentralization: Studies on the constitutional status, powers, finances, accountability, and functioning of Panchayats, municipalities, urban local bodies, and other institutions of decentralized governance. Constitutional Dimensions of Public Policy: Research on constitutional issues arising in education, public health, environmental protection, social security, migration, digital governance, economic policy, and other areas of public administration and welfare. Human Rights and Constitutional Justice: Studies on the relationship between constitutional rights and human rights, including access to justice, refugee and migrant rights, child rights, disability rights, custodial protections, and constitutional safeguards for vulnerable communities. Technology, Privacy, and Emerging Constitutional Rights: Research on data protection, surveillance, artificial intelligence, digital identity, internet access, online expression, algorithmic governance, biometric systems, and emerging constitutional questions created by technological change. Comparative Constitutional Law: Comparative research on constitutions, constitutional courts, rights adjudication, federal structures, separation of powers, amendment processes, democratic institutions, and constitutional developments across jurisdictions. Indian Constitutional Law and Contemporary Developments: Research on the Constitution of India, Supreme Court and High Court jurisprudence, constitutional amendments, governance reforms, federal relations, fundamental rights, Directive Principles, and contemporary constitutional controversies. Comparative and interdisciplinary studies are welcome where constitutional law or jurisprudence forms the central scholarly contribution.

name: Journal of Capital Market and Securities Law
subject_areas: Resource Mobilization in the International Capital Market
scope: Securities Law and Capital Market Regulation: Research on the legal and regulatory framework governing securities markets, capital formation, market conduct, disclosure, investor protection, and the powers and responsibilities of securities regulators, with particular attention to Indian and comparative regulatory developments. Equity, Debt, and Hybrid Securities: Studies on shares, bonds, debentures, convertible instruments, structured securities, sovereign and corporate debt, credit ratings, issuance practices, and the legal rights and obligations associated with capital-market instruments. Public Issues, Private Placements, and Listing Regulation: Research on initial public offerings, follow-on offerings, rights issues, preferential allotments, private placements, listing requirements, disclosure obligations, prospectus liability, and continuing compliance by listed entities. Securities Market Intermediaries: Studies on the regulation, governance, duties, and liability of brokers, merchant bankers, investment advisers, portfolio managers, underwriters, research analysts, market makers, custodians, registrars, and other securities-market intermediaries. Stock Exchanges and Market Infrastructure Institutions: Research on stock exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories, clearing and settlement systems, market surveillance, trading infrastructure, risk-management mechanisms, and regulation designed to preserve market integrity and financial stability. Investor Protection and Securities Enforcement: Examination of investor rights, disclosure failures, mis-selling, market abuse, enforcement proceedings, regulatory investigations, penalties, compensation mechanisms, grievance redressal, securities litigation, and collective investor remedies. Market Manipulation, Insider Trading, and Securities Fraud: Research on insider trading, fraudulent and unfair trade practices, price manipulation, front-running, misleading disclosures, unlawful market conduct, financial fraud, and legal standards for investigation, evidence, liability, and sanctions. Mutual Funds and Collective Investment Schemes: Studies on mutual funds, alternative investment structures, pooled investment vehicles, collective investment schemes, fund governance, fiduciary responsibilities, disclosure, valuation, investor protection, and regulatory compliance. Venture Capital, Private Equity, and Alternative Investment Funds: Research on venture capital, private equity, alternative investment funds, startup financing, fund formation, investment agreements, exits, governance rights, regulatory requirements, and their interaction with securities and corporate law. Derivatives and Complex Financial Products: Legal and regulatory studies on futures, options, swaps, commodity-linked securities, derivatives trading, structured products, margin requirements, clearing obligations, risk disclosure, and the regulation of complex financial instruments. Corporate Governance and Listed Companies: Research on board accountability, shareholder rights, related-party transactions, disclosure standards, stewardship, executive compensation, corporate control, ESG disclosures, and governance obligations applicable to listed companies. Depositories, Dematerialisation, and Securities Settlement: Studies on electronic holding and transfer of securities, depository participants, beneficial ownership, settlement systems, dematerialisation, pledge and encumbrance of securities, and legal issues arising from digital securities infrastructure. Cross-Border Capital Markets and International Securities Regulation: Research on foreign portfolio investment, depository receipts, external commercial borrowings, cross-border listings, international capital raising, regulatory cooperation, extraterritorial securities regulation, and comparative securities-law frameworks. FinTech, Digital Assets, and Technology in Securities Markets: Studies on algorithmic and high-frequency trading, artificial intelligence, blockchain, tokenised securities, digital assets, online investment platforms, RegTech, cybersecurity, market data, and emerging regulatory challenges arising from technology-driven capital markets. Securities Dispute Resolution and Adjudication: Research on securities appellate mechanisms, regulatory adjudication, tribunals, courts, arbitration, mediation, investor grievance systems, enforcement appeals, and other mechanisms for resolving capital-market disputes. Indian Securities Law and Regulatory Developments: Research on Indian securities and capital-market law, including the Securities and Exchange Board of India framework, securities contracts regulation, depositories law, company-law provisions affecting listed entities, regulatory circulars, judicial decisions, and continuing market reforms. Comparative and interdisciplinary studies are welcome where the securities-law or capital-market regulatory contribution is substantial.

name: Journal of Family and Adoption Law
scope: Marriage and Matrimonial Law: Research on the legal formation, validity, registration, dissolution, and consequences of marriage, including personal laws, civil marriage, matrimonial rights and obligations, restitution of conjugal rights, judicial separation, and evolving concepts of marital relationships. Divorce, Separation, and Matrimonial Disputes: Studies on grounds for divorce, mutual-consent divorce, separation, maintenance, alimony, property division, matrimonial cruelty, desertion, mediation, settlement, and judicial approaches to resolving family disputes. Child Custody, Guardianship, and Parenting Rights: Research on custody standards, guardianship, parental responsibility, visitation, shared parenting, relocation disputes, child welfare, best-interest principles, and judicial assessment of parental fitness in custody proceedings. Child Support and Maintenance: Studies on maintenance obligations, determination of child support, paternity-related issues, medical and educational expenses, support for children with special needs, enforcement of maintenance orders, and financial responsibilities of parents. Adoption Law and Legal Procedures: Research on domestic and inter-country adoption, eligibility, consent, adoption procedures, legal status of adopted children, rights and duties of adoptive parents, adoption agencies, judicial oversight, and regulatory compliance. Inter-Country Adoption and International Family Law: Studies on cross-border adoption, recognition of adoption orders, international child protection, habitual residence, jurisdiction, conflicts of laws, international conventions, and cooperation between national authorities in family matters. Rights of Children and Child Protection: Research on the legal protection of children from abuse, neglect, exploitation, trafficking, abandonment, and family violence, including child welfare systems, institutional care, foster care, rehabilitation, and access to justice. Foster Care, Guardianship, and Alternative Family Care: Studies on foster care systems, kinship care, guardianship arrangements, institutional and non-institutional care, permanency planning, and legal frameworks for children who cannot remain with their biological families. Domestic Violence and Family Protection: Research on domestic abuse, intimate-partner violence, protection orders, residence rights, economic abuse, family-court interventions, victim support, and legal remedies designed to protect vulnerable family members. Maintenance, Alimony, and Economic Rights in Families: Studies on spousal maintenance, interim maintenance, permanent alimony, economic dependency, matrimonial property, inheritance-related family claims, and financial protection following separation or divorce. Reproductive Rights and Assisted Family Formation: Research on surrogacy, assisted reproductive technologies, parentage, donor conception, reproductive autonomy, legal motherhood and fatherhood, and emerging questions concerning technologically assisted family formation. Family Mediation and Alternative Dispute Resolution: Studies on mediation, conciliation, negotiation, counselling, collaborative processes, online dispute resolution, and other non-adversarial methods for resolving matrimonial, custody, maintenance, and adoption-related disputes. Personal Laws and Family Justice: Research on Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Parsi, secular, customary, and other personal-law systems governing marriage, divorce, maintenance, succession, guardianship, and adoption, including constitutional and comparative analysis. Gender, Equality, and Family Law: Studies on gender justice, equality within marriage, LGBTQ+ family rights, same-sex relationships, domestic partnerships, women’s rights, marital autonomy, discrimination, and the evolving legal recognition of diverse family structures. Technology and Family Law: Research on digital evidence in matrimonial disputes, online harassment, social media and family conflicts, privacy, electronic communication, digital assets, artificial intelligence, online mediation, and technology-assisted family justice. Comparative and International Family Law: Comparative research on marriage, divorce, custody, adoption, maintenance, reproductive rights, child protection, and family-court systems across jurisdictions, including international and transnational developments. Indian Family and Adoption Law: Research on Indian legislation, personal laws, judicial decisions, adoption frameworks, guardianship, maintenance, child custody, matrimonial remedies, family courts, and contemporary legal reforms affecting families and adopted children. The journal welcomes doctrinal, empirical, comparative, and interdisciplinary scholarship where family law or adoption law forms the central contribution.

name: Journal of Human Rights Law and Practice
subject_areas: Human Rights Aspects of Genocide, Torture, and Capital Punishment
Human Rights in the Indian Context
Laws of War and War Crimes
Social Status of Women and Children
Status of Social and Economically Disadvantaged People
scope: Foundations of Human Rights Law: Research on the philosophical, constitutional, ethical, and jurisprudential foundations of human rights, including dignity, equality, liberty, justice, autonomy, and the relationship between individual rights and state obligations. International Human Rights Law: Studies on international human rights treaties, conventions, customary international law, United Nations human rights mechanisms, treaty bodies, special procedures, and the implementation of international human rights obligations at national and regional levels. Constitutional and Fundamental Rights: Research on constitutional guarantees of fundamental rights, judicial interpretation, constitutional remedies, due process, equality, dignity, privacy, freedom of expression, religious freedom, and socio-economic rights, with particular attention to developments in India. Human Rights Enforcement and Accountability: Examination of courts, commissions, tribunals, ombuds institutions, national human rights institutions, international monitoring bodies, complaint mechanisms, remedies, reparations, and other systems for the enforcement and protection of human rights. Human Rights Violations and Access to Justice: Research on discrimination, arbitrary detention, custodial violence, torture, forced displacement, trafficking, exploitation, denial of basic rights, and barriers to legal remedies, including institutional responses to human rights violations. Rights of Women, Children, and Gender Minorities: Studies on gender equality, violence and discrimination, reproductive rights, child protection, education, health, family law, workplace rights, gender identity, sexual orientation, and legal measures designed to protect vulnerable groups. Rights of Marginalized and Disadvantaged Communities: Research on the rights and social justice concerns of economically disadvantaged persons, scheduled castes and tribes, indigenous peoples, minorities, persons with disabilities, migrants, refugees, older persons, and other marginalized communities. Economic, Social, and Cultural Rights: Examination of the rights to health, education, housing, livelihood, food, water, sanitation, social security, culture, and decent working conditions, including state obligations and policy frameworks for their realization. Civil and Political Rights: Research concerning freedom of speech and expression, association, assembly, religion, movement, voting rights, political participation, privacy, personal liberty, fair trial, and protection against arbitrary state action. International Humanitarian Law and Armed Conflict: Studies on the protection of human rights during armed conflicts, international humanitarian law, war crimes, crimes against humanity, genocide, treatment of civilians and prisoners, and accountability under international criminal law. Torture, Capital Punishment, and Criminal Justice: Legal and policy research on torture, cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment, custodial rights, death penalty jurisprudence, prison conditions, policing, criminal procedure, fair trial rights, and human rights safeguards within justice systems. Business and Human Rights: Research on corporate responsibility, human rights due diligence, labour rights, supply chains, environmental and social impacts of business activity, corporate accountability, and national and international frameworks governing business conduct. Technology, Privacy, and Digital Rights: Studies on data protection, surveillance, artificial intelligence, algorithmic discrimination, cybersecurity, freedom of expression online, digital access, platform governance, biometric technologies, and emerging human rights issues in the digital environment. Migration, Refugees, and Displacement: Research on refugee law, asylum, migration governance, statelessness, internal displacement, trafficking, border controls, citizenship, deportation, and human rights protections for migrants and displaced populations. Human Rights, Public Policy, and Governance: Analysis of legislation, public policy, administrative action, welfare programs, institutional governance, and law-reform initiatives affecting the protection and realization of human rights. Indian Human Rights Law and Comparative Perspectives: Research on human rights under the Constitution of India, the role of courts and the National Human Rights Commission, statutory protections, public-interest litigation, and comparative studies placing Indian human rights law within regional and international frameworks.

name: Journal of Intellectual Property rights Law
scope: Patent Law and Innovation Protection: Research on patentability, novelty, inventive step, industrial applicability, patent prosecution, ownership, licensing, compulsory licensing, infringement, remedies, patent term, and the legal protection of technological innovation. Copyright and Creative Works: Studies on copyright protection, authorship, ownership, registration, licensing, infringement, fair dealing, exceptions and limitations, digital reproduction, collective management, and the protection of literary, artistic, musical, audiovisual, software, and other creative works. Trademark Law and Brand Protection: Research on trademark registration, classification, distinctiveness, passing off, infringement, dilution, deceptive similarity, well-known marks, domain names, brand protection, and enforcement of trademark rights. Trade Secrets and Confidential Information: Studies on the protection of trade secrets, confidential business information, non-disclosure agreements, breach of confidence, employee obligations, misappropriation, contractual safeguards, and remedies for unauthorized disclosure or use. Industrial Designs and Design Protection: Research on registration, ownership, infringement, enforcement, commercialization, and international protection of industrial designs, including the relationship between design rights, copyright, patents, and trademarks. Geographical Indications and Traditional Products: Studies on the protection, registration, enforcement, and commercialization of geographical indications, including agricultural goods, handicrafts, traditional products, regional reputation, producer rights, and conflicts with trademarks. Intellectual Property Licensing and Technology Transfer: Research on patent, copyright, trademark, software, and technology licensing; assignment; franchising; research collaborations; commercialization; royalty arrangements; university technology transfer; and contractual management of intellectual property. Digital Intellectual Property and Emerging Technologies: Studies on intellectual property issues arising from artificial intelligence, machine-generated content, blockchain, digital platforms, software, databases, virtual environments, 3D printing, and other emerging technologies. Intellectual Property Enforcement and Dispute Resolution: Research on civil and criminal remedies, injunctions, damages, border enforcement, customs measures, administrative proceedings, litigation, arbitration, mediation, and other mechanisms for resolving intellectual property disputes. International and Comparative Intellectual Property Law: Studies on TRIPS, WIPO-administered treaties, the Patent Cooperation Treaty, Madrid and Hague systems, international copyright frameworks, cross-border enforcement, and comparative approaches to intellectual property protection. Intellectual Property, Competition, and Market Regulation: Research on the interaction between intellectual property and competition law, including licensing restraints, standard-essential patents, FRAND obligations, abuse of dominance, patent pools, market access, and anti-competitive use of intellectual property rights. Intellectual Property and Public Interest: Studies on the relationship between intellectual property protection and public health, access to medicines, education, research, food security, environmental sustainability, technology access, and broader public-interest considerations. Traditional Knowledge, Cultural Expressions, and Biodiversity: Research on the legal protection of traditional knowledge, traditional cultural expressions, indigenous innovation, genetic resources, biodiversity-related intellectual property, benefit sharing, biopiracy, and community rights. Intellectual Property Commercialization and Valuation: Studies on IP management, valuation, portfolio strategy, commercialization, securitization, due diligence, intellectual-property audits, startup innovation, investment, and the role of intangible assets in business and economic development. Patent Information and Intellectual Property Analytics: Research on patent databases, prior-art searching, patent landscaping, citation analysis, freedom-to-operate studies, intellectual-property analytics, technology intelligence, and the use of patent information in research and innovation strategy. Indian Intellectual Property Law and Policy: Research on Indian patent, copyright, trademark, design, geographical indication, trade-secret, and related intellectual property laws, including legislative developments, judicial decisions, administrative practice, and policy reforms. Comparative and interdisciplinary work is welcome where intellectual property law is a central component of the research.

name: Journal of Law of Torts and Consumer Protection Law
subject_areas: Origin and Development of Law of Torts
scope: Foundations and Development of Tort Law: Research on the historical, doctrinal, and jurisprudential development of tort law, including the evolution of civil wrongs, judicial innovation, changing standards of liability, and the relationship of tort law with contract, property, and public law. Negligence and Duty of Care: Studies on duty of care, breach, causation, foreseeability, standards of reasonable conduct, professional negligence, contributory negligence, assumption of risk, and evolving judicial approaches to liability for negligent acts. Strict, Absolute, and No-Fault Liability: Research on strict liability, absolute liability, hazardous and inherently dangerous activities, enterprise liability, statutory liability, environmental harm, product-related risks, and compensation mechanisms that do not depend on proof of fault. Vicarious and State Liability: Studies on employer liability, institutional responsibility, liability of public authorities, sovereign and non-sovereign functions, public-duty claims, professional malpractice, and contemporary developments in vicarious liability. Causation, Remoteness, and Assessment of Damages: Research on factual and legal causation, intervening acts, remoteness, foreseeability, mitigation, contributory fault, pecuniary and non-pecuniary loss, punitive damages, and principles governing assessment and allocation of compensation. Defamation, Privacy, and Personality Rights: Studies on defamation, reputation, privacy, freedom of speech and expression, public-interest communication, media liability, online publication, intermediary responsibility, and the balance between personal rights and expressive freedoms. Product Liability and Consumer Safety: Research on defective products, unsafe goods and services, manufacturer and seller liability, duty to warn, product recalls, consumer safety standards, compensation, and regulatory approaches to product-related harm. Consumer Rights and Unfair Trade Practices: Studies on consumer rights, misleading advertisements, unfair or restrictive trade practices, deceptive marketing, unfair contract terms, quality deficiencies, pricing, disclosure obligations, consumer choice, and business accountability. Consumer Protection in Digital and E-Commerce Transactions: Research on online marketplaces, digital contracts, platform liability, electronic payments, subscription services, dark patterns, online fraud, data-driven marketing, consumer consent, and remedies arising from digital commerce. Medical and Professional Liability: Studies on medical negligence, professional malpractice, informed consent, standard of care, institutional liability, professional accountability, compensation claims, and tortious responsibility in healthcare and other professional services. Motor Accident and Personal Injury Compensation: Research on road-traffic liability, motor accident claims, personal injury, disability compensation, fatal accident claims, insurance-related compensation, assessment of damages, and victim-oriented legal remedies. Environmental and Mass Tort Liability: Studies on industrial disasters, pollution, toxic exposure, public nuisance, environmental damage, mass claims, collective injury, corporate responsibility, compensation schemes, and liability for widespread or long-term harm. Emerging Torts and Technology-Related Liability: Research on artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, algorithmic harm, cybersecurity incidents, data breaches, digital defamation, privacy violations, platform misconduct, and other technology-driven forms of civil liability. Consumer Dispute Resolution and Redressal Mechanisms: Studies on consumer commissions, courts, mediation, arbitration, online dispute resolution, class or representative actions, grievance mechanisms, enforcement of orders, and access to effective consumer remedies. Comparative and International Tort and Consumer Law: Comparative research on tort liability, consumer protection regimes, product liability, damages, collective redress, cross-border transactions, and international approaches to consumer welfare and civil compensation. Indian Tort and Consumer Protection Law: Research on Indian tort principles, judicial developments, constitutional torts, the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, product liability, consumer commissions, e-commerce regulation, compensation jurisprudence, and contemporary reforms. The journal welcomes doctrinal, empirical, comparative, and interdisciplinary scholarship where tort law or consumer protection forms the central legal contribution.

name: Journal of Advanced Database Management & Systems
subject_areas: Temporal, Spatial, and High dimensional databases
Data warehousing and data mining, OLAP
Distributed, Parallel, P2P, and Grid-based Database
E-business and m-commerce models and architectures
Web database and Web-based information systems
scope: Data models and database design: relational, object-oriented, document, and graph data models, conceptual and logical modelling, schema design and normalisation, schema evolution and versioning, and design methodologies for data-intensive applications. Query processing and optimisation: query languages and algebra, cost-based and rule-based optimisation, join and aggregation algorithms, adaptive and approximate query processing, query execution engines, and workload-aware tuning. Transaction management and concurrency: concurrency control protocols, isolation levels and consistency models, recovery and logging, distributed transactions and consensus, advanced transaction models, and workflow and long-running transaction systems. Storage, indexing, and access methods: physical storage layout, row and column stores, in-memory and persistent memory databases, index structures including B-trees, hash, bitmap, and learned indexes, compression, and buffer and cache management. Distributed, parallel, and cloud databases: sharding and replication strategies, distributed query execution, parallel and massively parallel processing architectures, cloud-native and serverless data services, peer-to-peer and grid-based data systems, and elasticity and resource management. Spatial, temporal, and high-dimensional data: spatio-temporal indexing and query processing, multidimensional access structures, similarity and nearest-neighbour search, vector databases and embedding retrieval, trajectory and moving object databases, and outlier detection in high-dimensional spaces. Stream and real-time data management: continuous query processing, complex event processing, windowing and time-series models, stream ingestion architectures, sensor and IoT data management, and latency-aware data pipelines. Data warehousing, OLAP, and analytics: dimensional modelling and warehouse design, ETL and ELT pipelines, data lakes and lakehouse architectures, online analytical processing and cube computation, materialised view selection and maintenance, and decision support system design. Data mining and knowledge discovery: association, clustering, and classification methods over databases, scalable mining algorithms, pattern and sequence discovery, in-database machine learning, and integration of analytics with query engines. Semi-structured and document data: XML, JSON, and native document stores, schema-flexible data management, path and tree query processing, indexing of semi-structured data, and interoperability between structured and semi-structured sources. Semantic technologies and knowledge representation: ontology design and engineering, description logics and reasoning, RDF stores and SPARQL processing, knowledge graph construction and querying, and semantic integration of heterogeneous sources. Data quality, integration, and provenance: entity resolution and deduplication, schema and data matching, data cleaning and repair, uncertainty and incompleteness, provenance tracking and lineage, and measurement frameworks for data quality. Database security, privacy, and integrity: discretionary, mandatory, and role-based access control, content-dependent authorisation, encryption of data at rest and in transit, privacy-preserving query processing, differential privacy in data systems, auditing and compliance, and integrity constraints and enforcement. Databases for emerging workloads: scientific and array databases, large-scale matrix and tensor operations, bioinformatics and genomic data management, multimedia and unstructured content stores, blockchain and immutable ledgers, and data infrastructure for machine learning pipelines. Systems analysis, design, and software engineering for data-intensive systems: requirements engineering for data applications, agile and iterative development practice, object-oriented and model-driven design methods, software quality and defect prediction, testing of data-intensive software, and empirical studies of database system development. Web-based and information system applications: web-based information systems, information flow control in data-driven applications, digital libraries and scholarly information systems, content and citation retrieval, and enterprise and e-commerce data architectures.

name: Journal of Automobile Engineering and Applications
scope: Vehicle Dynamics: validation, simulation, modeling, vehicle dynamics, Vehicle dynamics, Motion control, Equations, Kinetic theory, Road vehicles, Bicycles, Mathematical models, Tires, MATLAB, Analytical models. Noise, Vibration, and Harshness Engineering: air-borne noise, automotive VNH, fluid-borne noise, vehicle noise, operating conditions, research, root cause, structure-borne noise, unusual NVH, usual NVH, vehicle vibration, harshness. Fluid Dynamics and Aerodynamics: Aerodynamics, Euler Method, Finite Difference Method, Fluid Flows, Gas Dynamics, Lax Scheme, Mixed-Type Scheme, Murman-Cole Method, Runge-Kutta Method, Stability of Numerical Schemes, Upwind Scheme, convection, fluid dynamics, simulation, fluid- and aerodynamics. Automotive Diesel Engines: Biodiesel–diesel blend, Ethanol–diesel blend, Emission, Rural economy, common rail, OBDII, OBM, CFD simulation, environmental safety, fuel nozzles, Isuzu 4FH1. Vehicle Body Engineering: lightweight design, car body, HS steel, light alloys, composite materials, Vehicle body, FEM, DOE method, Modal analysis, Frequency map, NVH, RSM. Engine Construction and Operation: Gasification, Low tar, Biomass, Engine, Deposits, Condensate, human-machine interface in education, full-mission simulator, marine engine room, marine engineers education, NOx reduction in exhaust gases, fuel-water emulsion. Keywords: Engine Construction and Operation Vibration Harshness Engineering Vehicle Dynamics

name: Journal of Alternate Energy Sources & Technologies
scope: Solar Energy: Solar photovoltaic systems, solar thermal energy, concentrated solar power, solar heating and cooling, solar radiation, solar tracking, solar collectors, building-integrated photovoltaics, solar desalination, solar fuels, and emerging solar technologies. Photovoltaic Technologies: Crystalline silicon cells, thin-film photovoltaics, perovskite solar cells, tandem cells, organic photovoltaics, PV modules, MPPT, PV system modelling, degradation, efficiency improvement, and grid-connected PV systems. Wind Energy: Wind turbines, wind farms, wind-resource assessment, aerodynamic modelling, turbine control, offshore wind, wind forecasting, wind-power integration, hybrid wind systems, and turbine condition monitoring. Hydropower: Conventional hydropower, small and micro-hydropower, pumped storage, hydro-turbine systems, run-of-river plants, hydroelectric generation, reservoir management, and sustainable hydropower technologies. Tidal and Marine Energy: Tidal-stream systems, tidal barrages, tidal lagoons, wave energy, ocean-current energy, salinity-gradient energy, marine turbines, and ocean renewable-energy technologies. Bioenergy and Biomass: Biomass conversion, biogas, biofuels, bioethanol, biodiesel, waste-to-energy, anaerobic digestion, algae-based fuels, biochar, biomass gasification, and sustainable bioenergy systems. Hydrogen Energy: Green hydrogen, electrolysis, hydrogen production, storage, transport, hydrogen fuel cells, power-to-hydrogen, hydrogen blending, hydrogen infrastructure, and hydrogen economy studies. Fuel Cells: Proton-exchange membrane fuel cells, solid-oxide fuel cells, alkaline fuel cells, direct-methanol fuel cells, fuel-cell modelling, fuel processing, durability, and fuel-cell applications. Geothermal Energy: Geothermal reservoirs, ground-source heat pumps, enhanced geothermal systems, geothermal power generation, geothermal resource assessment, drilling technologies, and thermal-energy utilization. Waste-to-Energy Technologies: Municipal solid waste conversion, refuse-derived fuel, landfill gas, pyrolysis, gasification, incineration, anaerobic digestion, industrial waste-energy recovery, and circular-energy systems. Energy Storage Systems: Batteries, supercapacitors, thermal storage, pumped storage, compressed-air energy storage, flywheels, hydrogen storage, hybrid storage, and grid-scale energy-storage technologies. Battery Technologies: Lithium-ion, sodium-ion, solid-state batteries, flow batteries, battery-management systems, state-of-charge estimation, state-of-health estimation, degradation, recycling, and second-life applications. Thermal Energy Storage: Sensible heat, latent heat, phase-change materials, thermochemical storage, solar thermal storage, district thermal storage, and building energy-storage applications. Renewable Energy Integration: Grid-connected renewable systems, hybrid energy systems, distributed generation, microgrids, inverter-based resources, grid stability, renewable forecasting, and high-renewable penetration studies. Smart Grids and Microgrids: Smart-grid architecture, AC/DC microgrids, energy-management systems, demand response, distributed energy resources, virtual power plants, grid automation, and intelligent energy control. Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems: Solar-wind systems, renewable-storage integration, hybrid microgrids, diesel-renewable systems, hydrogen-renewable integration, multi-source energy systems, and optimal hybrid configurations. Energy Management: Energy planning, energy conservation, demand-side management, energy audits, facility energy management, energy procurement, load management, cost optimization, and energy-efficiency strategies. Energy Efficiency: Building energy efficiency, industrial energy efficiency, high-efficiency appliances, energy-saving technologies, efficiency benchmarking, energy-performance assessment, and conservation measures. Building Energy and Sustainable Architecture: Net-zero buildings, passive solar design, building-integrated renewables, HVAC efficiency, green buildings, building energy modelling, smart buildings, and low-energy architecture. Industrial Energy Systems: Waste-heat recovery, industrial electrification, process-energy optimization, cogeneration, combined heat and power, energy-intensive industries, and industrial decarbonization. Climate and Energy Systems: Climate impacts on renewable resources, climate-sensitive energy demand, greenhouse-gas mitigation, weather-energy interactions, climate resilience of energy infrastructure, and climate-energy modelling. Meteorology for Renewable Energy: Solar irradiance forecasting, wind forecasting, atmospheric conditions, weather prediction, climatology, extreme-weather impacts, and meteorological data for energy planning. Greenhouse Gas Reduction: Carbon mitigation, emissions reduction, carbon accounting, decarbonization pathways, carbon capture integration, lifecycle emissions, and net-zero energy strategies. Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage: CO₂ capture technologies, carbon utilization, geological storage, industrial carbon management, negative-emission technologies, and integrated low-carbon energy systems. Energy Economics and Policy: Renewable-energy policy, tariffs, subsidies, carbon pricing, energy markets, investment analysis, techno-economic assessment, regulatory frameworks, and energy transition policies. Energy Finance and Investment: Green finance, renewable project finance, lifecycle cost analysis, cost-benefit analysis, investment risk, levelized cost of energy, and sustainable-energy financing. Energy Systems Modelling and Optimization: Energy-system simulation, techno-economic modelling, optimization, scenario analysis, integrated energy planning, energy forecasting, and decision-support systems. Artificial Intelligence in Energy Systems: Machine learning for forecasting, predictive maintenance, energy optimization, load prediction, renewable resource assessment, fault diagnosis, and intelligent energy management. IoT and Digital Energy Systems: IoT-enabled energy monitoring, smart meters, remote asset monitoring, connected energy systems, digital substations, edge analytics, and smart energy platforms. Digital Twins for Energy Systems: Digital replicas of energy assets, predictive simulation, renewable-plant monitoring, virtual commissioning, performance optimization, and lifecycle asset management. Electric Mobility and Renewable Energy: EV charging, renewable-powered charging, vehicle-to-grid, battery integration, solar EV charging, electric mobility infrastructure, and clean transportation-energy systems. Rural and Decentralized Energy Systems: Mini-grids, off-grid systems, rural electrification, solar home systems, decentralized renewable technologies, community energy, and energy access. Sustainable Energy for Agriculture: Solar irrigation, renewable-powered cold storage, biomass energy, agricultural waste utilization, farm energy management, and clean-energy technologies for rural production. Desalination and Water-Energy Systems: Solar desalination, renewable-powered water treatment, water-energy nexus, low-energy desalination, clean-energy pumping, and sustainable water systems. Emerging Alternative Energy Technologies: Artificial photosynthesis, ocean thermal energy conversion, piezoelectric harvesting, thermoelectric energy, microbial fuel cells, osmotic power, airborne wind energy, and next-generation renewable concepts.
