Tax Ethics and Goods and Services Tax: Research on ethical and governance issues related to taxation, GST compliance, tax transparency, tax avoidance, taxpayer responsibility, corporate tax behavior, and the broader relationship between taxation, business responsibility, and public interest. Employment Ethics and Workplace Responsibility: Studies on fairness in employment, discrimination, harassment, employee rights, equal opportunity, workplace dignity, labor practices, employee surveillance, compensation ethics, diversity, inclusion, and ethical responsibilities within employer–employee relationships. Management Ethics and Organizational Culture: Research on ethical management practices, organizational values, ethical climates, codes of conduct, managerial responsibility, compliance culture, workplace integrity, organizational justice, and systems for preventing misconduct. Marketing, Sales, and Consumer Ethics: Studies on truthful advertising, misleading claims, pricing fairness, sales practices, consumer manipulation, data-driven marketing, influencer disclosure, customer privacy, product responsibility, and ethical dimensions of marketing and sales. Healthcare and Professional Ethics: Research on ethical issues in healthcare management, medical organizations, professional conduct, patient rights, confidentiality, resource allocation, informed consent, and ethical responsibilities in health-related institutions. Healthcare ethics is part of the journal’s existing scope. Sustainability, ESG, and Business Responsibility: Studies on environmental, social, and governance practices, sustainability reporting, climate responsibility, green business, social impact, responsible supply chains, ethical sourcing, and corporate accountability for environmental and societal outcomes. Stakeholder Ethics and Corporate Accountability: Research on relationships between organizations and shareholders, employees, consumers, suppliers, governments, communities, and civil society, including stakeholder rights, accountability, participation, transparency, and trust. Business Ethics in the Global Economy: Studies on ethical challenges in multinational corporations, globalization, outsourcing, global supply chains, cross-border business practices, cultural differences, international labor standards, anti-corruption, and responsible conduct in global markets. This reflects the journal’s stated interest in business ethics and the global economy. Corruption, Fraud, and Ethical Compliance: Research on bribery, corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, misconduct, compliance systems, anti-corruption programs, internal controls, ethical audits, whistleblower protection, and organizational approaches to preventing unethical behavior. Behavioral Ethics and Moral Psychology: Studies on cognitive bias, moral disengagement, ethical fading, moral emotions, social influence, bounded ethicality, identity, personality, group norms, and psychological mechanisms affecting ethical choices in business contexts. Virtue Ethics and Ethical Theory in Business: Research applying virtue ethics, deontology, consequentialism, justice theory, care ethics, stakeholder theory, and related philosophical approaches to contemporary problems in business and management. Virtue theory is explicitly included in the journal’s current scope. Digital Business, Artificial Intelligence, and Technology Ethics: Studies on artificial intelligence, algorithmic decision-making, data privacy, surveillance, automation, digital platforms, cybersecurity, responsible innovation, and ethical governance of emerging technologies in business. Supply Chain and Procurement Ethics: Research on responsible sourcing, supplier conduct, modern slavery, child labor, human rights due diligence, environmental responsibility, fair trade, procurement integrity, and ethical risk management across global supply chains. Entrepreneurship and Small Business Ethics: Studies on ethical challenges in startups, family businesses, SMEs, social enterprises, entrepreneurial leadership, investor relations, business formation, stakeholder responsibility, and responsible growth. Business Ethics Education and Professional Development: Research on ethics education, professional training, ethical competency, case-based learning, curriculum development, responsible management education, and methods for strengthening ethical awareness among students and practitioners. Emerging Issues in Business Ethics and CSR: Research on new and evolving ethical challenges arising from artificial intelligence, sustainability transitions, platform economies, remote work, stakeholder activism, climate responsibility, social inequality, and changing expectations of corporate conduct.

name: NOLEGEIN Journal of Business Risk management
subject_areas: Innovation and techniques for disaster control and management
Managing hazardous chemicals in the workplace
scope: Enterprise Risk Management: Research on enterprise-wide risk frameworks, risk identification, assessment, prioritization, treatment, monitoring, and integration of risk management with corporate strategy, governance, internal controls, and organizational performance. Disaster Risk Reduction and Preparedness: Studies on disaster prevention, preparedness, vulnerability assessment, early warning, evacuation planning, community resilience, risk awareness, emergency shelters, and institutional strategies for reducing the impact of natural and human-made disasters. Disaster Relief, Recovery, and Humanitarian Logistics: Research on post-disaster relief operations, humanitarian aid, recovery planning, supply-chain design, emergency distribution, resource allocation, reconstruction, community-based recovery, and resilience-building after disasters. Business Continuity and Organizational Resilience: Studies on business continuity planning, continuity of operations, disaster recovery, contingency planning, operational resilience, business impact analysis, crisis preparedness, resource recovery, and organizational adaptation to disruptive events. Crisis Management and Crisis Leadership: Research on organizational crises, executive decision-making, leadership under uncertainty, crisis governance, institutional response, stakeholder coordination, recovery leadership, and managerial strategies for maintaining organizational stability during emergencies. Crisis Communication and Reputation Risk: Studies on crisis communication, public relations, social media, stakeholder communication, transparency, risk messaging, public trust, organizational reputation, communication planning, and information management during emergencies and disruptive events. Governance, Risk, and Regulatory Compliance: Research on governance-risk-compliance frameworks, regulatory obligations, corporate accountability, internal and external audit, risk committees, compliance systems, certification, standards, and regulatory risk across industries. Cybersecurity and Digital Business Risk: Studies on cyber threats, data breaches, cybercrime, ransomware, information-security risk, cybersecurity culture, cyber resilience, digital vulnerability, cyber-risk assessment, mitigation strategies, and the business impact of cybersecurity incidents. Information Technology Risk Management: Research on IT governance, technology risk, system failure, digital continuity, information security, enterprise architecture, technology adoption, digital transformation risk, and the management of operational and strategic risks associated with information systems. Supply Chain Risk and Resilience: Studies on supply-chain disruptions, supplier risk, logistics uncertainty, product traceability, recalls, security risks, sourcing vulnerabilities, operational continuity, supply-network resilience, and risk mitigation across domestic and global supply chains. Financial and Strategic Risk Management: Research on financial risk, market uncertainty, credit and liquidity risk, strategic risk, investment risk, enterprise value, management control, risk appetite, opportunity management, and integration of financial and strategic risk into organizational decision-making. Operational Risk and Internal Control: Studies on process failures, human error, fraud, system breakdown, internal control mechanisms, audit, compliance monitoring, operational loss, process resilience, and managerial approaches to reducing operational exposure. Fraud, Scams, and Business Crime Risk: Research on business email compromise, phishing, financial fraud, Ponzi schemes, crowdfunding fraud, deceptive business practices, cyber-enabled scams, illegal entrepreneurship, fraud detection, and organizational prevention mechanisms. Infrastructure Risk and Critical Systems Resilience: Studies on risks affecting power systems, transportation, telecommunications, water utilities, public infrastructure, healthcare facilities, and other critical systems, including resilience planning, interdependency, continuity, and policy responses. Environmental and Climate-Related Business Risk: Research on climate change, natural hazards, environmental sustainability, water scarcity, floods, landslides, forest fires, biodiversity impacts, resource risk, environmental exposure, and business adaptation to climate-related threats. Occupational Health, Safety, and Hazardous Materials Risk: Studies on chemical hazards, toxicological risk, hazardous materials, workplace accidents, environmental and human-health risk assessment, control measures, occupational exposure, and safety management systems. Risk Analytics, Modelling, and Decision Support: Research using quantitative risk models, scenario analysis, simulation, fuzzy methods, multi-criteria decision-making, predictive analytics, vulnerability modelling, risk matrices, and data-driven methods for business-risk assessment and management. Technology for Disaster and Risk Management: Studies on GIS, remote sensing, satellite communication, Internet of Things, automation, collaborative networks, digital platforms, early-warning technologies, artificial intelligence, and other technological tools used for disaster preparedness and risk control. Public Policy, Community Resilience, and Risk Governance: Research on government policy, public preparedness, community participation, nonprofit organizations, socio-economic vulnerability, public-health preparedness, environmental justice, inclusive development, and multi-stakeholder approaches to risk governance. Emerging and Interdisciplinary Business Risks: Research on geopolitical uncertainty, pandemics, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, global supply disruptions, sustainability transitions, emerging technologies, social instability, and other evolving risks that materially affect organizations, industries, or economies.

name: NOLEGEIN Journal of Corporate & Business Laws
scope: Corporate Law and Business Regulation: Research on company formation, corporate personality, corporate powers, statutory compliance, regulatory frameworks, and the legal responsibilities of companies operating in domestic and international markets. Corporate Governance and Board Accountability: Studies on board structure, directors’ duties, fiduciary obligations, shareholder oversight, executive accountability, board independence, corporate disclosure, transparency, and governance reforms affecting public and private companies. Corporate Contracts and Commercial Transactions: Research on contract formation, performance, breach, remedies, force majeure, specific performance, commercial obligations, negotiation, drafting, and interpretation of business agreements in domestic and cross-border transactions. Agency, Delegation, and Principal–Agent Relationships: Studies on agency law, delegated management, principal–agent problems, moral hazard, adverse selection, managerial incentives, portfolio delegation, fiduciary responsibilities, and contractual mechanisms for aligning stakeholder interests. Mergers, Acquisitions, and Corporate Restructuring: Research on mergers, takeovers, amalgamations, demergers, joint ventures, corporate reorganizations, due diligence, shareholder protection, regulatory approvals, and legal issues arising from corporate restructuring. Securities, Capital Markets, and Corporate Finance: Studies on securities issuance, capital raising, debt and equity financing, investor protection, disclosure requirements, corporate financing arrangements, portfolio management, asset pricing, and legal aspects of capital-market participation. Competition Law and Market Regulation: Research on anti-competitive agreements, abuse of dominance, merger control, market concentration, unfair competition, digital-market regulation, and the relationship between competition law and corporate strategy. Insolvency, Bankruptcy, and Corporate Distress: Studies on corporate insolvency, restructuring, creditor rights, resolution processes, liquidation, distressed assets, directors’ duties during financial distress, and legal frameworks for business rescue. Corporate Compliance, Ethics, and Risk Management: Research on compliance systems, internal controls, corporate investigations, whistleblowing, anti-corruption measures, legal risk management, ethical governance, regulatory enforcement, and organizational accountability. Digital Markets and Technology-Driven Business Law: Studies on digital platforms, online marketplaces, e-commerce, data-driven business models, artificial intelligence, blockchain, algorithmic decision-making, and emerging legal issues associated with technology-enabled commercial activity. This retains the journal’s existing emphasis on digital markets and informational support while placing it within a clearer corporate-law framework. Data Governance, Privacy, and Corporate Information Management: Research on corporate data governance, commercial use of data, information security, privacy obligations, data sharing, digital records, cybersecurity compliance, and legal responsibilities associated with business information systems. Corporate Social Responsibility and ESG: Studies on corporate social responsibility, environmental, social and governance obligations, sustainability reporting, stakeholder engagement, non-financial disclosure, responsible investment, and legal accountability for corporate sustainability commitments. Business Globalization and Cross-Border Corporate Law: Research on multinational enterprises, cross-border business structures, foreign investment, international commercial transactions, subsidiary governance, transnational corporate regulation, and legal issues arising from globalization. Shareholder and Stakeholder Rights: Studies on shareholder remedies, minority protection, voting rights, derivative actions, stakeholder participation, investor activism, employee interests, creditor protections, and the balancing of competing interests within corporate governance. Corporate Dispute Resolution and Commercial Litigation: Research on corporate litigation, shareholder disputes, contractual disputes, arbitration, mediation, conciliation, commercial courts, enforcement of awards, and other mechanisms for resolving business and corporate conflicts. Corporate Taxation and Regulatory Compliance: Studies on the interaction between corporate law and taxation, including tax governance, corporate structuring, compliance obligations, cross-border tax issues, and legal risks associated with business taxation. Intellectual Property and Commercialization: Research on licensing, technology transfer, franchising, trade secrets, intellectual-property commercialization, brand protection, corporate innovation, and contractual arrangements involving intangible business assets. International and Comparative Corporate Law: Comparative research on company law, corporate governance, business regulation, shareholder protection, commercial contracting, corporate accountability, and cross-border legal frameworks across different jurisdictions. Indian Corporate and Business Law: Research on the Companies Act, securities regulation, insolvency law, competition law, foreign-investment regulation, commercial contracting, judicial developments, and contemporary reforms affecting Indian businesses. Comparative and interdisciplinary work is welcome where corporate or business law forms the central legal contribution.

name: NOLEGEIN Journal of Consumer Behavior & Market Research

Advertising and Promotional Effectiveness: Research on advertising response, sales promotion, comparative advertising, mobile advertising, digital campaigns, copy testing, media effectiveness, purchase intention, consumer involvement, promotional strategy, and the influence of advertising on brand and purchase outcomes. Digital Marketing and Social Media Behavior: Studies on social media marketing, influencer marketing, electronic word of mouth, online reviews, viral communication, digital engagement, mobile marketing, online advertising, platform-based marketing, and consumer behavior across digital environments. Customer Satisfaction, Loyalty, and Relationship Management: Research on customer satisfaction, perceived quality, customer experience, service quality, retention, loyalty, customer lifetime value, relationship marketing, customer relationship management, and the drivers of long-term customer–firm relationships. Product Research and New Product Development: Studies on product innovation, product design, product performance, product life cycle, new product adoption, product-service systems, product safety, product recalls, customer feedback, diffusion of innovation, and consumer response to new market offerings. Pricing, Value Perception, and Purchase Decisions: Research on price sensitivity, perceived value, willingness to pay, reference pricing, discounting, price fairness, promotional pricing, demand elasticity, choice behavior, and the influence of pricing on consumer decisions. Choice Modeling and Consumer Analytics: Studies using discrete choice models, conjoint analysis, multinomial and mixed logit models, latent-class models, decision trees, random forests, machine learning, simulation, and other analytical approaches to explain or predict consumer preferences and market choices. Competitive Intelligence and Market Strategy: Research on competitor analysis, strategic positioning, market intelligence, market orientation, SWOT analysis, competitive advantage, business intelligence, market commonality, strategic decision-making, and firm responses to competitive environments. Marketing Performance and Effectiveness: Studies on marketing productivity, return on marketing investment, campaign effectiveness, marketing capabilities, resource allocation, customer and shareholder value, sales performance, channel effectiveness, and measurement of marketing outcomes. Retail, E-Commerce, and Omnichannel Consumer Behavior: Research on online shopping, marketplaces, retail formats, omnichannel journeys, digital storefronts, e-commerce trust, website quality, platform experience, consumer retention, online purchase behavior, and interactions between physical and digital retail channels. Neuromarketing and Biometric Consumer Research: Studies using neuroscience, biometrics, eye tracking, electroencephalography, physiological signals, facial coding, and other behavioral measurement techniques to understand attention, emotion, memory, engagement, and decision-making in marketing contexts. Sustainable, Ethical, and Green Consumer Behavior: Research on green marketing, ecolabels, sustainable consumption, ethical purchasing, corporate social responsibility, environmental product development, responsible advertising, consumer trust, and the behavioral drivers of sustainable marketplace choices. Cross-Cultural and International Consumer Research: Studies on cultural influences on consumer behavior, international marketing, cross-country comparisons, global branding, intercultural consumption, emerging markets, market entry, adaptation versus standardization, and consumer responses across different cultural and economic environments. Service Marketing and Customer Experience: Research on service quality, service encounters, experience design, employee–customer interactions, customer delight, complaint behavior, service recovery, satisfaction, value creation, and management of customer experiences across service sectors. Marketing Research Methods and Advanced Analytics: Studies on structural equation modeling, multivariate analysis, CHAID, cluster analysis, data mining, sentiment analysis, text analytics, bibliometrics, experimental research, ethnography, mixed methods, and artificial intelligence applications in consumer and market research. Emerging Trends in Consumer and Market Research: Research on artificial intelligence, personalization, recommendation systems, virtual and augmented reality, social commerce, platform economies, privacy, algorithmic marketing, digital communities, and other emerging technologies or market developments that materially affect consumer behavior and marketing practice.

name: National Journal of Criminal Law
subject_areas: Crime Relating to Women – Historical Retrospect
scope: Substantive Criminal Law: Research on the principles, doctrines, and interpretation of criminal law, including criminal liability, mens rea, actus reus, general exceptions, abetment, attempt, conspiracy, and the classification and punishment of offences. Criminal Justice System and Administration: Research on the functioning of police, prosecution, courts, prisons, correctional institutions, forensic agencies, and other components of the criminal justice system, including institutional reforms and access to justice. Crimes Against Women and Gender-Based Violence: Studies on rape, sexual offences, domestic violence, dowry-related offences, workplace sexual harassment, trafficking, stalking, acid attacks, and other forms of gender-based violence, including legal remedies and enforcement challenges. Crimes Against Children and Juvenile Justice: Research on juvenile delinquency, child abuse, sexual offences against children, child trafficking, child protection laws, rehabilitation, restorative justice, and the operation of juvenile justice institutions. Criminology and Penology: Studies on theories and patterns of crime, criminal behaviour, victimology, recidivism, punishment, prison administration, rehabilitation, correctional policies, restorative justice, and alternatives to incarceration. Cybercrime and Technology-Enabled Crime: Research on cyber fraud, identity theft, online harassment, digital evidence, technology-facilitated offences, artificial intelligence and crime, cryptocurrency-related offences, and legal responses to emerging forms of digital criminality. Organized Crime, Terrorism, and Financial Crime: Studies on organized criminal networks, terrorism, money laundering, corruption, illicit trafficking, economic offences, proceeds of crime, and national and international legal frameworks for investigation and prosecution. Forensic Science and Criminal Investigation: Research on forensic evidence, medico-legal investigation, digital forensics, DNA evidence, crime-scene investigation, expert testimony, evidentiary reliability, and the use of scientific methods in criminal adjudication. Victim Rights and Victimology: Studies on the rights, protection, compensation, participation, and rehabilitation of victims of crime, including victim-impact processes, witness protection, restorative mechanisms, and access to legal remedies. Prison Law, Sentencing, and Correctional Justice: Research on sentencing policy, proportionality, probation, parole, remission, prison conditions, prisoners’ rights, rehabilitation, correctional administration, and reforms in custodial institutions. Human Rights and Criminal Justice: Examination of custodial violence, torture, arbitrary detention, unlawful surveillance, death penalty, police accountability, fair-trial guarantees, and the relationship between criminal justice institutions and constitutional or human rights protections. Economic and Corporate Crime: Research on fraud, bribery, corruption, corporate criminal liability, white-collar crime, market-related offences, financial misconduct, regulatory offences, and enforcement mechanisms affecting businesses and public institutions. Comparative and International Criminal Law: Studies on comparative criminal justice systems, transnational crime, extradition, mutual legal assistance, international criminal law, cross-border investigation, and comparative approaches to criminal-law reform. Criminal Law Reform and Public Policy: Research on legislative reform, judicial developments, sentencing policy, police reform, prosecutorial policy, decriminalization, criminalization, and evidence-based approaches to improving the criminal justice system. Indian Criminal Law and Contemporary Developments: Research on Indian criminal law, including developments under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, judicial decisions, constitutional principles, and emerging challenges in criminal justice administration. The journal also welcomes comparative and interdisciplinary work with a clear connection to criminal law or criminal justice.

ICANN’s Core Principles and Domain Names Disputes

name: Research & Reviews: Discrete Mathematical Structures
subject_areas: Calculus of finite differences, discrete calculus or discrete analysis
scope: The journal welcomes original research articles, theoretical and computational papers, systematic literature reviews, case studies, short communications, and invited editorials in the following thematic areas: Logic and Boolean Algebra: propositional and first-order logic, Boolean algebra and lattice theory, fuzzy logic and multivalued logic systems, modal and temporal logics, logic programming and automated theorem proving, and applications to digital systems and circuits. Set Theory and Foundations: naive and axiomatic set theory, fuzzy set theory and extensions, partial orders and lattices, category theory fundamentals, type theory and lambda calculus, and mathematical foundations of discrete structures. Relations, Functions, and Mappings: binary and n-ary relations, function composition and properties, injective, surjective, and bijective functions, equivalence relations and partitions, relational databases and query theory, and functional programming theory. Graph Theory and Combinatorics: graph structures and properties (directed, undirected, weighted), graph algorithms and traversal methods, tree structures and spanning trees, graph coloring and matching problems, planar graphs and topological properties, and combinatorial optimization. Number Theory and Cryptography: divisibility and prime numbers, modular arithmetic and congruences, greatest common divisor and least common multiple, number-theoretic functions, cryptographic applications, and computational number theory. Algorithms and Computational Theory: algorithm design and analysis, computational complexity classes (P, NP, NP-complete), sorting and searching algorithms, dynamic programming and greedy algorithms, graph algorithms and approximation methods, and computational hardness. Sequences, Series, and Recurrence: sequences and series summation, recurrence relations and solutions, generating functions and closed-form formulas, linear recurrences and matrix methods, and applications to combinatorial enumeration. Matrix Theory and Linear Algebra (Discrete Context): matrix operations and determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, systems of linear equations, applications to graphs and networks, Boolean matrices, and spectral methods in discrete optimization. Discrete Probability and Counting: combinatorial enumeration and counting principles, permutations and combinations, probability distributions on finite spaces, Markov chains and random walks, stochastic processes on discrete domains, and Monte Carlo methods. Boolean Functions and Switching Theory: Boolean function analysis and representations, switching circuits and logic gates, function minimization and normal forms, fault detection and testing, and hardware design applications. Coding Theory and Information Theory: error-correcting codes and code design, information entropy and source coding, Shannon's theorems and capacity analysis, cryptographic coding, and applications to communication systems. Discrete Calculus and Difference Equations: finite differences and difference operators, discrete analogues of calculus, recurrence equations and solutions, generating functions, discrete transforms (Fourier, Z-transform), and applications to signal processing. Applications to Computer Science and Engineering: iscrete structures in software algorithms, applications to database design and query optimization, discrete mathematics in artificial intelligence, network theory and optimization, and applications to physical and engineering systems.

name: Research & Reviews : Journal of Agricultural Science and Technology
scope: The journal particularly welcomes manuscripts addressing the following areas: Agronomy and Crop Science: crop production, cropping systems, crop physiology, crop nutrition, weed management, tillage, resource-use efficiency, sustainable crop management, and improvement of cereals, pulses, oilseeds, fibre crops, and other field crops. Agricultural Economics and Farm Management: production economics, agricultural and rural development, farm business management, agricultural markets, agricultural policy, resource allocation, productivity, employment, income, and economic dimensions of sustainable agriculture. Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering: farm machinery and power, agricultural mechanization, irrigation and drainage, soil and water engineering, erosion control, agricultural structures, controlled environments, automation, robotics, and engineering solutions for agricultural production. Precision and Digital Agriculture: agricultural sensors, remote sensing, unmanned aerial systems, geographic information systems (GIS), GPS-enabled technologies, Internet of Things applications, decision-support systems, artificial intelligence, machine learning, agricultural robotics, automation, and data-driven farming technologies. Agricultural Entomology and Pest Management: insect ecology, physiology, pathology, taxonomy and toxicology, crop pests, beneficial insects, pollinators, biological control, integrated pest management, and agriculturally relevant insect–plant interactions. Horticultural Science: fruit, vegetable, medicinal, aromatic, ornamental and plantation crops; floriculture; viticulture; plant propagation; protected cultivation; crop management; breeding; and pre- and post-harvest horticultural technologies. Soil Science and Soil Management: pedology, edaphology, soil physics and chemistry, pedometrics, soil fertility, soil microbiology, plant–soil interactions, nutrient cycling, soil biogeochemistry, soil organic matter, soil biodiversity, carbon sequestration, soil conservation, pollution, and remediation of agricultural soils. Agricultural Chemistry: fertilizers and nutrient inputs, soil and plant chemistry, agrochemicals, plant-growth regulators, pesticide chemistry, residue analysis, environmental fate of agricultural chemicals, and responsible chemical management in agricultural systems. Agricultural Biotechnology: genetic engineering, genome editing, molecular markers, molecular diagnostics, tissue culture, molecular breeding, mutation breeding, microbial biotechnology, beneficial endophytes, genetically modified organisms, and biotechnology for crop and livestock improvement. Agricultural Microbiology: soil and plant-associated microorganisms, agricultural microbiomes, bacteriology, mycology, plant–microbe interactions, microbial contributions to soil fertility and plant development, biological control, agricultural bioremediation, and microbial technologies supporting sustainable production. Agricultural Genetics and Breeding: crop and livestock genetics, quantitative genetics, population genetics, genomics, genetic diversity, germplasm characterization, genotype–phenotype relationships, marker-assisted and genomic selection, complex traits, and breeding for productivity, quality, resistance, and resilience. Agricultural Meteorology and Climate Science: agrometeorology, crop micrometeorology, phenology, climate variability and change, climate impacts on agricultural production, climate adaptation, agroclimatic risk, crop-weather modelling, yield forecasting, and weather information for farm decision-making. Agroecology and Sustainable Agricultural Systems: agroecosystem ecology, agroforestry, conservation agriculture, mixed farming, crop–livestock systems, biodiversity, ecosystem services, sustainable intensification, resource conservation, climate-resilient agriculture, and farming-system resilience.

name: Research and Reviews : A Journal of Ayurvedic Science, Yoga and Naturopathy
scope: The journal welcomes contributions across the following topic areas: AYURVEDA: Internal Medicine (Kaya Chikitsa): chronic disease management, metabolic disorders, respiratory conditions, neurological disorders, and general therapeutic interventions Surgery & Parasurgery (Shalya Tantra): surgical principles and techniques, orthopedic applications, management of trauma and tissue damage, and operative procedures Pediatrics & Gynecology (Kaumarbhritya): maternal and child health, reproductive health disorders, fetal development, neonatal care, and family medicine Toxicology (Agad Tantra): poison identification and management, antidote development, toxin treatment protocols, and prevention strategies Rejuvenation Therapy (Rasayan): anti-aging approaches, immune enhancement, longevity studies, and tissue regeneration Reproductive Health (Vajikaran): fertility enhancement, sexual dysfunction treatment, reproductive wellness, and herbal aphrodisiacs Detoxification & Purification (Panchkarma): therapeutic cleansing procedures, bioaccumulation reduction, post-treatment outcomes, and preventive detoxification YOGA: Therapeutic yoga and asana practice for disease management and health promotion Pranayama (breathing techniques) for respiratory and mental health Meditation and mindfulness practices Yoga for stress management, mental health, and psychological wellbeing Integrative yoga approaches in clinical settings NATUROPATHY: Natural healing modalities and lifestyle interventions Dietary and nutritional therapies Herbal and botanical medicine within naturopathic practice Environmental and climatic therapeutics Holistic wellness approaches and disease prevention

name: Research & Reviews : Journal of Botany
scope: Plant Biology and Botanical Sciences: Research on the structure, function, development, diversity, evolution, and ecological relationships of plants, including integrative studies that advance fundamental and applied understanding of plant systems. Plant Physiology and Functional Biology: Studies on photosynthesis, respiration, mineral nutrition, water relations, transport, plant growth, development, reproduction, signaling, stress physiology, and physiological responses of plants to environmental conditions. Plant Morphology, Anatomy, and Cytology: Research on external and internal plant structure, root, stem, leaf, flower, fruit and seed development, tissue organization, cell structure, cytogenetics, reproductive anatomy, and structural adaptations across plant groups. Plant Genetics, Genomics, and Breeding: Studies on heredity, genetic variation, molecular genetics, population genetics, quantitative genetics, genome analysis, gene expression, crop improvement, plant breeding, introgression, molecular markers, and genetic engineering. Plant Biotechnology and Molecular Botany: Research on plant tissue culture, transformation, genome editing, molecular breeding, recombinant technologies, gene regulation, plant molecular biology, and biotechnological approaches for crop, horticultural, and medicinal plant improvement. Phytochemistry and Plant Metabolites: Studies on primary and secondary metabolites, flavonoids, phenolics, terpenoids, alkaloids, carotenoids, phytosterols, essential oils, bioactive compounds, metabolomics, biosynthetic pathways, and chemical diversity in plants. Plant Pathology and Plant–Microbe Interactions: Research on fungal, bacterial, viral, nematode, and other plant diseases; pathogen biology; disease diagnosis; host resistance; plant–microbe interactions; epidemiology; and integrated approaches to disease management. Plant Ecology and Ecophysiology: Studies on plant populations, communities, ecosystems, landscape ecology, plant–environment interactions, ecological adaptation, biodiversity, succession, habitat relationships, and physiological responses to biotic and abiotic factors. Biodiversity, Taxonomy, and Systematics: Research on plant identification, classification, nomenclature, floristics, phylogenetics, molecular systematics, species diversity, biogeography, taxonomic revisions, and documentation of regional and global plant diversity. Agronomy and Crop Science: Studies on crop production, soil–plant relationships, water management, agroecology, crop physiology, productivity, cropping systems, sustainable agriculture, nutrient management, and plant-based solutions for food and agricultural systems. Horticulture and Economic Botany: Research on fruits, vegetables, ornamental plants, medicinal plants, plantation crops, post-harvest biology, propagation, cultivation, plant utilization, ethnobotany, and economically important plant resources. Arboriculture, Forestry, and Woody Plant Sciences: Studies on trees, shrubs, silviculture, afforestation, dendrology, forest regeneration, tree health, pruning, propagation, transplanting, urban forestry, and management of woody plant resources. Palynology and Palaeobotany: Research on pollen, spores, palynomorphs, fossil plants, palaeoecology, archaeobotany, taphonomy, palaeogeography, evolutionary history, and applications of palynological evidence in ecological and geological reconstruction. Forensic Botany: Studies applying plant science to forensic investigation, including plant morphology, anatomy, palynology, dendrochronology, plant systematics, forensic ecology, plant-derived trace evidence, and botanical evidence in medicolegal contexts. Plant Conservation and Restoration Biology: Research on threatened plants, conservation genetics, habitat restoration, seed banks, ex situ and in situ conservation, invasive species, restoration ecology, and strategies for preserving plant biodiversity. Plant Responses to Climate and Environmental Stress: Studies on drought, salinity, temperature extremes, flooding, pollution, nutrient stress, climate change, oxidative stress, and molecular, physiological, and ecological mechanisms of plant adaptation and resilience. Medicinal and Aromatic Plants: Research on taxonomy, cultivation, phytochemistry, pharmacognosy, bioactive compounds, conservation, sustainable utilization, and biological properties of medicinal and aromatic plant species. Emerging and Interdisciplinary Plant Sciences: Research integrating botany with bioinformatics, remote sensing, nanotechnology, environmental science, computational biology, omics, data science, and other emerging approaches where the principal contribution advances plant science. These updated headings retain the journal’s established coverage of plant science, ecology, physiology, morphology, genetics, phytochemistry, agronomy, arboriculture, palynology, and forensic botany while organizing them into clearer contemporary research domains.

name: Research & Reviews: A Journal of Bioinformatics
subject_areas: Biomedical Data Engineering, Databases, and Data Mining
scope: Bioinformatic Tools and Sequence Analysis : Sequence alignment and similarity searching, homology detection, sequence profiling, RNA and protein structure prediction, microarray and next-generation sequencing (NGS) analysis, read mapping, virulence and antimicrobial resistance gene prediction. Computational Genomics, Proteomics, and Metabolomics : Genome assembly and annotation, gene function prediction, orthology and pan-genome analysis, genome-wide association studies, SNP analysis, comparative genomic hybridization, gene and protein expression analysis, protein families, motif discovery, proteogenomics, genome evolution. Evolutionary Bioinformatics and Phylogenetic Analysis : Phylogenetic inference and tree visualization, comparative genomics, horizontal gene transfer, gene duplication, speciation, population genetics, DNA barcoding, species and serovar identification, niche modeling. Computational Biology and Systems Biology : Mathematical modeling and simulation, modeling of cell and tissue function, disease gene mapping, epigenomics and gene regulation, transcriptomics, non-coding RNA structure and function, statistical genetics, bioimage analysis, biomedical data privacy. Biological Network Analysis : Interactomes, gene regulatory networks, protein–protein interaction networks, metabolite networks, pathway analysis, network clustering, alignment, visualization, link prediction, perturbation analysis. Integrative Bioinformatics : Data integration and warehousing, metabolic and regulatory network simulation, signaling pathway modeling, integrative data and text mining, Gene Ontology and pathway enrichment profiling, whole-cell modeling. Biomedical Data Engineering, Databases, and Data Mining : Nucleotide, protein, structure, and pathway databases, taxonomic and microbiome data resources, high-throughput and single-cell data analysis, biomedical cloud computing, machine learning for biomedical data, biomedical signal analysis. Biomarker Identification : Computational discovery of predisposition, diagnostic, prognostic, and predictive biomarkers, mass spectrometry–based peptide identification, proteomic biomarker pipelines. Cancer Informatics and Medical Informatics : Multi-omics analysis for cancer detection, classification, and risk prediction, cancer genomic variation, targeted sequencing panels, single-cell cancer genomics, neoantigen prediction, clinical decision support, electronic health records, neuroinformatics, medical image analysis. Molecular Modeling and Dynamics : Homology modeling, receptor modeling and docking, protein–ligand and protein–peptide interactions, de novo ligand design, molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo simulation, molecular mechanics, semi-empirical, ab initio, and post-Hartree–Fock methods, protein folding simulation. Drug Designing : Structure-based and ligand-based drug design, virtual screening, fragment-based design, virtual library design, drug-likeness rules including Lipinski's rule of five, in silico ADME and toxicity prediction, drug target identification, chemical genomics. In Silico Technology and Synthetic Biology : Chemoinformatics, genetic circuit design, pathway construction, gene optimization, computational protein and metabolic engineering, programmed evolution, synthetic metagenomics, computational analysis of structural biology data. Biological Algorithm and Software Development : Evolutionary and parallel genetic algorithms, swarm intelligence and metaheuristics applied to biological problems, automated machine learning pipelines, bioinformatics software engineering, open-source libraries and workflows in R, Python, and Bioconductor. The journal publishes original research articles, review articles, software and database articles, and short communications. Wet-laboratory studies, chemical synthesis, and clinical trials with no computational or data analysis component are out of scope. The journal serves bioinformaticians, computational and systems biologists, biostatisticians, software developers, biomedical researchers, and drug discovery scientists.

name: Research and Reviews : Journal of Crop science and Technology
scope: The journal welcomes original research articles, systematic and narrative reviews, case studies, short communications, and invited editorials in the following thematic areas: Plant Physiology and Growth Regulation: crop plant functioning, photosynthesis, respiration, hormone signaling, nutrient uptake, developmental processes, and physiological responses to environmental stress. name: Research and Reviews: A Journal of Dentistry
subject_areas: Dental Public Health (Policies Related to Oral Health)
scope: Dental Anatomy : Morphology of incisors, canines, premolars, and molars, crown and root structure, periodontal ligament and alveolar bone, epithelial and connective tissue attachment, oral mucosa and gingiva, hard and soft palate, tongue, parotid, submandibular, and sublingual glands. Prosthodontics : Complete and partial dentures, implant-supported prostheses, crowns and bridges, occlusion, esthetics, rehabilitation after tooth, bone, and soft tissue loss, prosthetic management of congenital and developmental defects. Dental Anesthesiology : Local anesthetic drugs, sedation and general anesthesia in dentistry, pain management, dental pharmacology, medical emergencies in dental practice, pediatric and adult dental anesthesia. Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery : Tooth extraction, dental bone grafts, implant surgery, corrective jaw surgery, facial trauma surgery, cleft lip and palate surgery, reconstructive and facial cosmetic surgery, head and neck surgery, sleep apnea surgery. Orthodontics : Diagnosis and treatment of malocclusion, overbite, underbite, crowding, and spacing, fixed braces, clear aligners, elastics, removable plates, palatal expanders, lip and cheek bumpers, jaw growth guidance. Restorative Dentistry : Direct restorations and fillings, pit and fissure sealants, repair of fractured teeth, preservation of tooth structure, indirect restorations. Periodontics, Endodontics, and Pediatric Dentistry : Periodontal disease management, periodontal surgery, root canal treatment, pulp and periapical disease, oral health care for children. Dental Radiography : Intraoral and extraoral imaging, bitewing, periapical, occlusal, and panoramic radiographs, radiographic detection of caries, bone loss, and benign or malignant masses, radiation hazards. Forensic Odontology : Collection, storage, and examination of dental evidence, ante-mortem and post-mortem data comparison, bite mark analysis, dental DNA analysis, lip print analysis, facial reconstruction and superimposition, medico-legal applications. Geriatric Dentistry : Oral health of older adults, home-based dental care, edentulism and dentures, caries and periodontal disease, dry mouth and polypharmacy, oral candidiasis, oral mucositis, oral care in diabetes, Alzheimer's, and Parkinson's disease. Veterinary Dentistry : Prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of oral and maxillofacial disorders in animals, veterinary endodontics, periodontics, orthodontics, and prosthodontics, veterinary dental radiography, oral anomalies and defects. Dental Public Health (Policies Related to Oral Health) : Oral health improvement, dental public health intelligence, quality of dental services, oral health policy and strategy development, the role of dentistry within health services, academic dental public health. The journal publishes original research articles, review articles, clinical studies, case reports, and short communications. General medicine and cosmetic procedures with no oral or maxillofacial focus are out of scope. The journal serves dentists, dental specialists, oral surgeons, forensic odontologists, veterinary dentists, public health professionals, researchers, and dental students.

name: Research and Reviews : Journal of Dairy Science and Technology
subject_areas: Nutritional qualities of milk and dairy products
scope: Dairy Science and Milk Technology: Research on milk production, composition, quality, physicochemical properties, processing, preservation, packaging, storage, distribution, and technological innovations across dairy systems. Dairy Processing and Product Development: Studies on the manufacture and optimization of milk, cheese, yogurt, butter, fermented dairy products, milk powders, protein products, nutritional formulations, and value-added dairy foods, including texture, flavor, stability, and shelf life. Dairy Microbiology and Fermentation: Research on dairy microorganisms, starter cultures, probiotics, prebiotics, fermentation processes, microbial quality, spoilage, food safety, bio-preservation, and the role of beneficial microorganisms in dairy products. Milk Biochemistry and Dairy Biotechnology: Studies on milk proteins, lipids, lactose, enzymes, bioactive components, molecular processes, dairy cultures, recombinant technologies, enzyme applications, cell immobilization, bioprocessing, and biotechnology relevant to dairy production and processing. Nutritional Quality and Functional Dairy Foods: Research on the nutritional composition and health-related properties of milk and dairy products, including proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, bioactive peptides, probiotics, prebiotics, functional ingredients, and fortified dairy formulations. Bovine and Non-Bovine Milk Science: Studies on milk from cattle, buffaloes, goats, sheep, camels, yaks, donkeys, and other dairy species, including composition, yield, lipid and protein profiles, microbiology, technological properties, cheesemaking suitability, and breed- or species-specific characteristics. Human Milk and Lactation Science: Research on human milk composition, lactation biology, oligosaccharides, microbiome, maternal nutrition, breastfeeding, neonatal nutrition, prematurity, pasteurization, bioactive components, and the role of human milk in infant growth and development. Dairy Cattle Genetics and Breeding: Studies on selective breeding, crossbreeding, genomic selection, genetic diversity, milk-yield traits, fertility, longevity, disease resistance, environmental adaptability, and breeding strategies for sustainable dairy production. Animal Nutrition and Dairy Physiology: Research on feed, nutrients, metabolic pathways, hormones, reproductive physiology, immune function, feed efficiency, lactation biology, animal health, microbiome, and physiological factors influencing milk production and dairy-animal performance. Dairy Animal Behavior and Welfare: Studies on behavior, stress, housing, grazing, social interactions, adaptation, welfare indicators, reproductive behavior, management practices, and the relationship between animal welfare and dairy productivity. Livestock Production and Dairy Farm Management: Research on dairy-herd management, production systems, grazing, housing, breeding, feed management, health programs, productivity, farm economics, pasture-based systems, and strategies for improving efficiency and sustainability. Dairy Food Safety and Quality Assurance: Studies on microbial contamination, residues, adulteration, hygiene, quality control, hazard assessment, foodborne pathogens, traceability, processing safety, and analytical methods for ensuring the safety and quality of dairy products. Dairy Engineering and Process Technology: Research on thermal and non-thermal processing, separation, homogenization, membrane technologies, drying, refrigeration, automation, process optimization, dairy equipment, energy efficiency, and engineering solutions for milk and dairy-product manufacture. Dairy Waste Management and Environmental Sustainability: Studies on dairy effluents, wastewater treatment, waste valorization, greenhouse-gas emissions, water and energy use, circular-economy approaches, environmental impacts of dairy farming and processing, and sustainable dairy-production practices. Dairy Economics, Supply Chains, and Consumer Science: Research on dairy markets, consumer preferences, sensory quality, pricing, value chains, distribution systems, demand, food security, rural livelihoods, and economic dimensions of dairy production and processing. Emerging Technologies in Dairy Science: Studies on artificial intelligence, automation, biosensors, precision dairy farming, omics, nanotechnology, smart packaging, digital monitoring, rapid diagnostics, and other emerging technologies that improve dairy production, processing, safety, or quality. Interdisciplinary and Sustainable Dairy Systems: Research integrating dairy science with animal science, nutrition, microbiology, biotechnology, engineering, environmental science, food science, and public health, where the principal contribution advances dairy science or technology. These updated areas consolidate the journal’s existing coverage of milk science, dairy biotechnology, nutrition, breeding, animal physiology, behavior, and livestock management into clearer contemporary research domains.

name: Research & Reviews : Journal of Ecology
scope: Behavioral Ecology: Research on behavioral adaptations, social organization, mating systems, parental care, communication, cooperation, competition, sexual selection, conflict, and behavioral responses of organisms to ecological and environmental pressures. Population Ecology and Demography: Studies on population size, density, distribution, growth, life-history strategies, migration, reproductive patterns, demographic processes, population viability, and responses of plant and animal populations to environmental change. Community Ecology and Species Interactions: Research on the structure and dynamics of ecological communities, including competition, predation, herbivory, mutualism, parasitism, facilitation, food webs, species coexistence, biodiversity patterns, and biotic interactions across ecosystems. Ecosystem Ecology and Biogeochemical Processes: Studies on energy flow, nutrient cycling, primary productivity, decomposition, carbon dynamics, ecosystem functioning, ecosystem resilience, and interactions among biological, physical, and chemical components of terrestrial and aquatic systems. Evolutionary Ecology and Adaptation: Research on natural selection, adaptation, speciation, coevolution, life-history evolution, host–parasite relationships, ecological genetics, evolutionary responses to environmental change, and the ecological mechanisms shaping biological diversity. Molecular Ecology and Conservation Genetics: Studies applying molecular, genomic, and population-genetic approaches to biodiversity, gene flow, genetic diversity, phylogeography, speciation, hybridization, conservation, microbial diversity, and adaptation to changing environments. Landscape Ecology and Spatial Dynamics: Research on landscape structure, habitat connectivity, fragmentation, land-use change, spatial ecological processes, ecological corridors, ecosystem services, urban and regional landscapes, and the effects of human activity on ecological patterns. Restoration Ecology and Ecosystem Recovery: Studies on ecological restoration, habitat rehabilitation, revegetation, rewilding, recovery of degraded ecosystems, restoration monitoring, adaptive management, community assembly, and restoration of forests, grasslands, wetlands, rivers, coasts, and urban ecosystems. Terrestrial Ecology: Research on forests, grasslands, deserts, tundra, mountain ecosystems, savannas, agroecosystems, soil–plant–animal interactions, terrestrial biodiversity, ecosystem productivity, and ecological responses to climate, land-use, and resource pressures. Aquatic and Marine Ecology: Studies on rivers, lakes, streams, wetlands, estuaries, coastal zones, and marine ecosystems, including aquatic biodiversity, nutrient cycling, water quality, habitat dynamics, trophic interactions, ecosystem services, and environmental change. Microbial Ecology: Research on microorganisms in soil, water, plants, animals, and extreme environments, including microbial communities, biofilms, decomposition, symbiosis, nutrient cycling, bioremediation, microbial diversity, and environment–host–microbe interactions. Ecotoxicology and Environmental Stress: Studies on the ecological effects of pollutants, toxic chemicals, heavy metals, pesticides, microplastics, pharmaceuticals, and other environmental stressors, including biomarkers, exposure pathways, risk assessment, bioaccumulation, and ecosystem-level impacts. Climate Change Ecology: Research on ecological responses to climate variability and climate change, including shifts in species distribution, phenology, ecosystem productivity, biodiversity loss, adaptation, resilience, carbon cycling, and ecosystem-based mitigation strategies. Biodiversity, Conservation, and Wildlife Ecology: Studies on species diversity, threatened and endangered species, conservation planning, habitat management, wildlife populations, protected areas, ecological monitoring, invasive species, and strategies for conserving biological diversity. Urban Ecology and Human-Dominated Ecosystems: Research on ecological processes in cities and other human-modified environments, including urban biodiversity, green infrastructure, ecosystem services, pollution, land-use change, human–wildlife interactions, and sustainable urban ecosystems. Agroecology and Sustainable Ecosystems: Studies on agricultural ecosystems, crop–soil–biodiversity interactions, ecological intensification, pollination, pest regulation, soil health, landscape management, sustainable farming, and the ecological foundations of resilient food systems. Systems Ecology and Ecological Modelling: Research using mathematical, computational, network, and systems approaches to understand ecological processes, ecosystem dynamics, species interactions, biogeochemical cycles, biodiversity, and responses to environmental change. Applied Ecology and Environmental Management: Studies that apply ecological knowledge to environmental assessment, natural-resource management, conservation practice, ecosystem services, pollution management, climate adaptation, land restoration, and evidence-based environmental decision-making.

name: Research & Reviews: A Journal of Embedded System & Applications
scope: Embedded architectures and hardware platforms: microcontroller and microprocessor architecture, system-on-chip and system-on-module design, FPGA and reconfigurable platforms, memory hierarchy and storage subsystems for embedded use, heterogeneous and multicore embedded processors, and domain-specific accelerators. Real-time systems and operating systems: real-time scheduling theory and algorithms, worst-case execution time analysis, RTOS kernel design and comparison with general-purpose operating systems, latency and jitter characterisation, priority inversion and resource sharing protocols, and mixed-criticality scheduling. Embedded software engineering: firmware architecture and design patterns, model-driven development for embedded targets, code generation from Simulink and UML models, memory-constrained programming practice, build and deployment toolchains, and over-the-air update mechanisms. Hardware–software co-design: partitioning between hardware and software, co-simulation and virtual prototyping, design space exploration, interface synthesis, and performance and area trade-off analysis. Low-power and energy-aware design: dynamic voltage and frequency scaling, sleep mode and duty cycle management, energy harvesting for embedded nodes, battery lifetime modelling, power measurement methodology, and energy-efficient algorithm design. Peripheral interfacing and communication protocols: serial and parallel bus design including UART, SPI, I²C, and CAN, industrial fieldbus protocols, high-speed interface design, electromagnetic interference and signal integrity, storage interfaces for removable media, and timing and synchronisation across interfaces. Sensing, actuation, and signal conversion: sensor interfacing and conditioning circuits, analogue-to-digital and digital-to-analogue conversion, sampling and anti-aliasing design, data acquisition system architecture, actuator and motor control, and calibration and compensation techniques. Embedded networking and Internet of Things: wireless protocols for constrained devices, low-power wide area connectivity, mesh and sensor network stacks, edge gateway architecture, device provisioning and management at scale, and interoperability across heterogeneous embedded devices. Edge intelligence and embedded machine learning: model compression, quantisation, and pruning for constrained targets, inference acceleration on microcontrollers and neural processing units, on-device training and federated approaches, benchmarking of embedded ML workloads, and accuracy–energy trade-offs at the edge. Dependability and safety-critical systems: fault tolerance and redundancy in embedded design, watchdog and recovery mechanisms, reliability and availability modelling, certification under safety standards for automotive, avionics, and medical domains, and hazard and failure mode analysis. Embedded security: secure boot and root of trust, hardware security modules and trusted execution environments, side-channel attack analysis and countermeasures, firmware integrity and tamper resistance, cryptographic implementation on constrained devices, and vulnerability assessment of embedded products. Verification, validation, and testing: formal verification and model checking of embedded designs, hardware-in-the-loop and processor-in-the-loop testing, timing verification, fault injection, test coverage for embedded software, and debugging and tracing infrastructure. Application domains: automotive and vehicle control systems, industrial automation and robotics, medical and wearable devices, smart building and energy systems, agricultural and environmental monitoring, and aerospace and defence embedded platforms.

Food Processing and Preservation: thermal and non-thermal processing, pasteurization, sterilization, drying, refrigeration, freezing, fermentation, irradiation, extrusion, microwave processing, emerging preservation technologies, and shelf-life extension. Food Chemistry and Biochemistry: proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, vitamins, minerals, enzymes, pigments, flavors, bioactive compounds, food additives, chemical reactions during processing and storage, and physicochemical properties of foods. Food Packaging: conventional and advanced packaging, active and intelligent packaging, biodegradable and sustainable packaging materials, barrier properties, packaging–food interactions, and shelf-life applications. Food Biotechnology and Enzyme Technology: fermentation, enzymatic processing, food bioprocessing, starter cultures, probiotics, microbial biotechnology, bioreactors, enzyme kinetics, and biotechnology applications in food production. Food Quality, Sensory Science and Analysis: quality assurance, quality control, sensory evaluation, food grading, analytical methods, process monitoring, Good Manufacturing Practices, food standards, and product characterization. Food Authenticity, Traceability and Defense: food adulteration, authenticity testing, traceability systems, fraud detection, supply-chain integrity, and food-defense strategies. Functional Foods and Nutraceuticals: functional ingredients, bioactive compounds, probiotics, prebiotics, fortified foods, and scientifically supported development and characterization of health-oriented food products. Emerging Food Technologies: nanotechnology, novel processing technologies, smart sensors, artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, digital monitoring, and data-driven technologies developed or validated for food applications. Sustainable Food Processing: resource-efficient processing, waste and by-product valorization, circular food systems, sustainable packaging, energy and water efficiency, and environmental performance of food-processing technologies.

name: Research and Reviews : A Journal of Immunology
scope: Innate Immunity and Inflammation : Pattern recognition receptors, pathogen-associated molecular patterns, phagocytosis, complement, neutrophils, macrophages, dendritic cells, natural killer cells, mast cells, innate lymphoid cells, cytokines and chemokines, epithelial barriers. Adaptive Immunity : B and T lymphocytes, helper and memory T cells, cytotoxicity, antibody diversity, antigen receptors, MHC proteins, immunity to infection, immune-mediated inflammation. Developmental Immunology : Hematopoietic precursor cells, thymus and primary lymphoid organs, lymphocyte development, neonatal and pediatric immunity, maternal influences, placental development, immune aging. name: Research and Reviews : A Journal of Life Sciences
scope: Molecular and Cellular Life Sciences: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying living systems, including cell structure and function, cell signaling, membrane biology, organelles, cell division, apoptosis, intracellular transport, and molecular regulation of cellular processes. Genetics and Genomics: Studies on genes, heredity, mutations, genome organization, gene regulation, genetic variation, population genetics, quantitative genetics, molecular genetics, epigenetics, genomics, genome sequencing, recombinant DNA technology, and genetic disorders. Molecular Biology and Biotechnology: Research on DNA, RNA, proteins, gene expression, molecular cloning, PCR, sequencing, molecular hybridization, genome editing, recombinant technologies, molecular diagnostics, and biotechnological applications in health, agriculture, industry, and the environment. Biochemistry and Structural Biology: Studies on proteins, enzymes, carbohydrates, lipids, nucleic acids, hormones, metabolism, enzymology, molecular interactions, macromolecular structure, biochemical pathways, and the structural basis of biological functions. Cell Biology and Cytology: Research on cellular organization, cytoplasm, nucleus, epithelial cells, nerve cells, muscle cells, connective tissue cells, stem cells, cell differentiation, cell communication, and microscopic or imaging-based analysis of cellular systems. Developmental and Reproductive Biology: Studies on gametogenesis, fertilization, embryogenesis, organ development, developmental genetics, morphogenesis, differentiation, metamorphosis, reproductive biology, birth defects, aging, and developmental changes across the life cycle. Plant Sciences and Botany: Research on plant physiology, plant anatomy, plant biochemistry, plant genetics, plant development, plant–environment interactions, crop biology, horticulture, plant biotechnology, and physiological or molecular responses of plants to biotic and abiotic stress. Animal Biology and Zoology: Studies on animal physiology, anatomy, development, behavior, reproduction, adaptation, evolution, biodiversity, comparative biology, and molecular or cellular mechanisms in vertebrate and invertebrate organisms. Microbiology and Mycology: Research on bacteria, fungi, and other microorganisms, including microbial physiology, genetics, ecology, pathogenicity, host–microbe interactions, microbial biotechnology, antimicrobial resistance, and environmental or industrial microbiology. Biomedical and Translational Life Sciences: Studies linking fundamental biological discoveries with health and disease, including human physiology, molecular medicine, bioengineering, clinical microbiology, genomics, pharmacology, nutrition, biomarkers, disease mechanisms, and translational applications. Systems Biology and Bioinformatics: Research integrating biological data across genes, proteins, cells, tissues, organs, and organisms through computational biology, bioinformatics, network biology, omics technologies, mathematical modeling, and systems-level analysis. Biophysics and Quantitative Biology: Studies applying physical and mathematical principles to biological systems, including biomechanics, bioenergetics, bioelectricity, fluid dynamics, molecular biophysics, bio-optics, imaging, quantitative modeling, and physicochemical analysis of biological processes. Ecology and Environmental Life Sciences: Research on ecosystems, biodiversity, population ecology, conservation biology, environmental biology, climate–organism interactions, ecological monitoring, pollution biology, environmental health, and biological responses to environmental change. Evolutionary Biology and Phylogenetics: Studies on evolution, adaptation, speciation, natural selection, molecular evolution, evolutionary genetics, phylogenetics, comparative genomics, and the evolutionary relationships among organisms. Immunology and Host Defense: Research on innate and adaptive immunity, immune cells, immune signaling, inflammation, immunogenetics, immune regulation, host defense, autoimmune mechanisms, and interactions between immune systems and pathogens. Physiology and Integrative Biology: Studies on the function and regulation of organ systems, including nervous, endocrine, respiratory, circulatory, digestive, reproductive, urinary, musculoskeletal, and immune systems, as well as integrative responses to physiological and environmental challenges. Omics and High-Throughput Life Science Research: Research involving genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, single-cell analysis, high-throughput screening, multi-omics integration, and related computational approaches that advance understanding of biological systems. Interdisciplinary and Emerging Life Sciences: Research at the interface of biology with chemistry, physics, engineering, medicine, environmental science, data science, nanotechnology, and biotechnology, including emerging methods and concepts that contribute substantially to understanding living systems. The revised scope consolidates the journal’s current broad coverage of biology, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, biochemistry, biophysics, environmental science, biomedical science, systems biology, and developmental biology into clearer research domains.

name: Research and Reviews: A Journal of Microbiology and Virology
scope: General and Molecular Microbiology: Research on the biology, genetics, physiology, biochemistry, molecular mechanisms, evolution, and cellular organization of microorganisms, including bacteria, archaea, fungi, protozoa, and other microbial systems. Environmental Microbiology and Microbial Ecology: Research on microbial communities in soil, water, air, extreme environments, and ecosystems, including microbiomes, biofilms, biogeochemical cycling, microbial diversity, community interactions, and ecological responses to environmental change. Aquatic and Marine Microbiology: Studies on microbial communities in freshwater, groundwater, rivers, wetlands, coastal environments, and marine ecosystems, including microbial diversity, nutrient cycling, water quality, aquatic pathogens, and ecosystem functioning. Bioremediation and Environmental Biotechnology: Research on microbial degradation and transformation of pollutants, hydrocarbons, pesticides, toxic chemicals, heavy metals, and contaminated soil or water, including bioaugmentation, biostimulation, and microbial technologies for environmental restoration. Microbial Physiology and Biochemistry: Studies on microbial metabolism, growth, nutrient utilization, stress responses, membrane function, enzyme systems, protein expression, cellular adaptation, energy generation, and physiological responses to environmental conditions. Microbial Cytology and Cellular Microbiology: Research on microbial cell structure, membrane biology, cell division, intracellular organization, microbial interactions with host cells, cellular imaging, nanomicrobiology, and structure–function relationships in microorganisms. Host–Microbe and Virus–Host Interactions: Studies on molecular and cellular interactions between microorganisms or viruses and their hosts, including adhesion, invasion, immune responses, immune evasion, microbiota–host relationships, and determinants of susceptibility or resistance. Microbiome and Metagenomic Research: Research on human, animal, plant, soil, aquatic, and environmental microbiomes using culture-dependent and culture-independent approaches, including metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, microbial community profiling, and functional analysis. Antimicrobial Resistance and Microbial Control: Studies on mechanisms, emergence, transmission, surveillance, and control of antimicrobial resistance, together with antimicrobial agents, resistance genes, stewardship, alternative therapeutics, and strategies for controlling pathogenic microorganisms. Vaccines, Diagnostics, and Infectious Disease Technologies: Research on vaccines, molecular diagnostics, biosensors, serological methods, nucleic-acid-based detection, rapid diagnostic systems, biomarkers, and other technologies for detecting, preventing, or managing microbial and viral diseases. Emerging and Re-Emerging Infectious Diseases: Studies on newly emerging or resurgent microbial and viral diseases, zoonoses, outbreak epidemiology, pathogen evolution, transmission dynamics, surveillance, preparedness, and public-health responses. One Health Microbiology and Virology: Interdisciplinary research examining microbial and viral interactions among humans, animals, plants, and the environment, including zoonotic transmission, antimicrobial resistance, food safety, ecosystem health, and integrated disease surveillance. Applied, Comparative, and Translational Microbiology: Research translating microbiological and virological discoveries into applications in healthcare, agriculture, food, industry, environmental management, biotechnology, and public health. The journal welcomes original, review, methodological, and interdisciplinary studies that make a clear contribution to microbiology or virology.

Entomotoxicology : Toxicological analysis of arthropods, Diptera and fly larvae as toxicological specimens, drug detection in maggots, applications in forensic entomology. Forensic and Medical Toxicology : Analytical and clinical chemistry in death, poisoning, and drug use investigations, immunoassays, gas chromatography–mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry, metal detection. Safety Evaluation and Risk Assessment : Hazard identification, qualitative and quantitative risk assessment, workplace exposure assessment, health and safety risk management. Pharmaceutical Toxicology : Drug toxicity and drug safety, drug disposition, toxicity of drug delivery systems, cell protective therapies, preclinical safety in cancer therapeutics. The journal publishes original research articles, review articles, case reports, and short communications. Studies that describe how to produce, weaponize, or disseminate toxic agents are out of scope, as is drug formulation research with no toxicity endpoint. The journal serves toxicologists, pharmacologists, environmental and occupational health scientists, forensic analysts, regulators, and graduate students.
